<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>母悖论 · 中国王朝动力学</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@300;400;500;600;700;900&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --ink: #0d0f12;
    --ink-2: #15181d;
    --ink-3: #1d2128;
    --paper: #eae0cc;
    --paper-dim: #b8ad94;
    --paper-dark: #6b6452;
    --cinnabar: #c8412c;
    --cinnabar-dim: #8b2d1d;
    --jade: #6b8e7f;
    --jade-bright: #9bbfae;
    --gold: #c8a464;
    --gold-dim: #8b7340;
    --line: rgba(234,224,204,0.12);
    --line-strong: rgba(234,224,204,0.28);
    --shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  html, body {
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--paper);
    font-family: "Noto Serif SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    line-height: 1.7;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  body {
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%, rgba(200,65,44,0.08) 0%, transparent 45%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%, rgba(107,142,127,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, #0d0f12 0%, #0a0c0f 100%);
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  /* Subtle grain overlay */
  body::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 100;
    opacity: 0.4;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(234,224,204,0.025) 1px, transparent 0);
    background-size: 3px 3px;
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  }

  /* ========== HEADER ========== */
  header.masthead {
    padding: 60px 60px 40px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    position: relative;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,17,21,0.9), transparent);
  }

  .masthead-inner {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    gap: 60px;
    align-items: end;
  }

  .brand {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .brand-mark {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 12px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .brand-mark::before {
    content: '';
    display: inline-block;
    width: 28px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
  }
  .brand-title {
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    color: var(--paper);
  }
  .brand-subtitle {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  .preface {
    max-width: 540px;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.85;
    font-weight: 300;
    border-left: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    padding-left: 24px;
  }
  .preface strong {
    color: var(--paper);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .meta-stats {
    display: flex;
    gap: 32px;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }
  .stat {
    text-align: right;
  }
  .stat-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 48px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  /* ========== MAIN LAYOUT ========== */
  main {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 50px 60px 40px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    gap: 60px;
  }

  /* ========== SIDEBAR (DYNASTY NAV) ========== */
  aside.dynasty-nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 30px;
    align-self: start;
    height: calc(100vh - 60px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding-right: 8px;
  }
  aside.dynasty-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  aside.dynasty-nav::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
  aside.dynasty-nav::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--line-strong);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  .nav-label {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    padding-bottom: 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .nav-era {
    font-family: "Noto Serif SC", serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin: 22px 0 8px 0;
    padding-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line);
    text-transform: none;
    opacity: 0.8;
  }
  .nav-era:first-child {
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .nav-item {
    position: relative;
    padding: 12px 0 12px 22px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  }
  .nav-item:hover {
    padding-left: 28px;
  }
  .nav-item::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 8px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--paper-dark);
    transition: all 0.4s;
  }
  .nav-item:hover::before {
    width: 16px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
  }
  .nav-item.active::before {
    width: 16px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
    height: 2px;
  }
  .nav-item.active {
    padding-left: 28px;
  }
  .nav-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .nav-name {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }
  .nav-item.active .nav-name { color: var(--paper); }
  .nav-item:hover .nav-name { color: var(--paper); }
  .nav-period {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    margin-top: 2px;
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* ========== CONTENT ========== */
  .content {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* Hero block of selected dynasty */
  .dynasty-hero {
    margin-bottom: 50px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  }
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .dynasty-marker {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .dynasty-num-large {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 64px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .dynasty-period-large {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }
  .dynasty-name-large {
    font-size: 56px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--paper);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .dynasty-tagline {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--jade-bright);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--cinnabar);
    padding-left: 18px;
  }

  /* Mother Paradox - the core visualization */
  .mother-paradox {
    margin: 70px 0 60px;
    padding: 50px 0;
    position: relative;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .mp-label {
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--ink);
    padding: 0 24px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .mp-stage {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
    gap: 30px;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .mp-pole {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 30px 24px;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }
  .mp-pole-a {
    text-align: right;
  }
  .mp-pole-b {
    text-align: left;
  }
  .mp-pole-marker {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .mp-pole-text {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--paper);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .mp-pole-a .mp-pole-text { color: var(--jade-bright); }
  .mp-pole-b .mp-pole-text { color: var(--cinnabar); }

  .mp-tension {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 80px;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 200;
    line-height: 1;
    position: relative;
    animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.08); }
  }

  .mp-description {
    max-width: 820px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    font-size: 14.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.95;
    text-align: justify;
    font-weight: 300;
    text-indent: 2em;
  }
  .mp-description::first-letter {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--paper);
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  /* ========== TENSIONS GRID ========== */
  .tensions-section {
    margin-top: 70px;
  }

  .section-heading {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
    padding-bottom: 18px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .section-heading-cn {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--paper);
  }
  .section-heading-en {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .section-heading-line {
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--line);
  }
  .section-heading-count {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .tensions-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(330px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--line);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .tension-card {
    background: var(--ink);
    padding: 28px 26px;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .tension-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
    transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }
  .tension-card:hover {
    background: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .tension-card:hover::before {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .tc-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 34px;
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .tc-num-label {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-style: normal;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .tc-poles {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .tc-pole {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--paper);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    line-height: 1.4;
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 14px;
  }
  .tc-pole::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 9px;
    width: 6px;
    height: 1px;
  }
  .tc-pole.a::before { background: var(--jade); }
  .tc-pole.b::before { background: var(--cinnabar); }
  .tc-pole.a { color: var(--jade-bright); }
  .tc-pole.b { color: var(--cinnabar); }
  .tc-vs {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2px 0;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  .tc-summary {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.75;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--line);
  }

  .tc-expand {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }
  .tension-card:hover .tc-expand {
    color: var(--cinnabar);
  }

  /* ========== META CONCLUSION ========== */
  .meta-conclusion {
    margin-top: 70px;
    padding: 40px 50px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(200,65,44,0.06), rgba(107,142,127,0.04));
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    position: relative;
  }
  .meta-conclusion::before {
    content: '元结论';
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px;
    left: 30px;
    background: var(--ink);
    padding: 0 18px;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--gold);
  }
  .mc-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--paper);
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .mc-text {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.95;
    font-weight: 300;
    text-align: justify;
  }

  /* ========== NAVIGATION CONTROLS ========== */
  .dynasty-controls {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-top: 70px;
    padding-top: 30px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .dc-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    color: var(--paper);
    padding: 14px 30px;
    font-family: "Noto Serif SC", serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 4px;
    min-width: 200px;
  }
  .dc-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--cinnabar);
    background: rgba(200,65,44,0.08);
  }
  .dc-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.3;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }
  .dc-btn-label {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .dc-btn-name {
    color: var(--paper);
  }
  .dc-btn-next { align-items: flex-end; }

  /* ========== MODAL (TENSION DETAIL) ========== */
  .modal-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(8,9,12,0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    z-index: 200;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 40px;
  }
  .modal-overlay.active {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  .modal {
    background: var(--ink-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    max-width: 760px;
    width: 100%;
    max-height: 85vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 50px 60px;
    position: relative;
    transform: translateY(20px);
    transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    box-shadow: 0 25px 60px var(--shadow);
  }
  .modal-overlay.active .modal {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--line-strong); }
  .modal-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 24px;
    right: 24px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 20px;
  }
  .modal-close:hover {
    border-color: var(--cinnabar);
    color: var(--cinnabar);
  }
  .modal-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .modal-title {
    font-size: 26px;
    color: var(--paper);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    line-height: 1.4;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .modal-poles {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }
  .modal-pole {
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    font-size: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }
  .modal-pole.a { color: var(--jade-bright); border-color: var(--jade); }
  .modal-pole.b { color: var(--cinnabar); border-color: var(--cinnabar-dim); }
  .modal-vs {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    font-size: 14px;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .modal-body {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 2;
    text-align: justify;
    font-weight: 300;
  }
  .modal-body p {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    text-indent: 2em;
  }
  .modal-body p:first-child { text-indent: 0; }
  .modal-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-top: 24px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  /* ========== META PARADOX BAR ========== */
  .meta-thread {
    background: var(--ink-3);
    padding: 28px 60px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .mt-inner {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .mt-label {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .mt-label-en {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .mt-label-cn {
    font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--paper);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .mt-content {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 24px;
    font-size: 18px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .mt-pole-a {
    color: var(--jade-bright);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .mt-symbol {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 28px;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 200;
    animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .mt-pole-b {
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .mt-note {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-align: right;
    line-height: 1.5;
    max-width: 200px;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* ========== FOOTER ========== */
  footer {
    padding: 50px 60px 40px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    margin-top: 60px;
    background: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .foot-inner {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: end;
  }
  .foot-text {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    line-height: 1.8;
    max-width: 760px;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .foot-mark {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-align: right;
  }

  /* ========== RESPONSIVE ========== */
  @media (max-width: 1100px) {
    main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 40px 30px; gap: 40px; }
    aside.dynasty-nav { position: static; height: auto; max-height: none; }
    .dynasty-name-large { font-size: 40px; }
    .dynasty-num-large { font-size: 44px; }
    .mp-pole-text { font-size: 22px; }
    .mp-tension { font-size: 56px; }
    .mp-stage { gap: 16px; }
    header.masthead { padding: 40px 30px; }
    .masthead-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 30px; }
    .preface { max-width: 100%; }
    .meta-stats { justify-content: flex-start; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .dynasty-name-large { font-size: 32px; }
    .mp-stage { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .mp-pole-a, .mp-pole-b { text-align: center; }
    .mp-pole-text { font-size: 20px; }
    .meta-conclusion { padding: 30px 24px; }
    .modal { padding: 32px 24px; }
    .meta-thread { padding: 20px 24px; }
    .mt-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; text-align: center; }
    .mt-note { text-align: center; max-width: 100%; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="masthead">
  <div class="masthead-inner">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="brand-mark">Dynastic Dynamics</div>
      <div class="brand-title">母悖论</div>
      <div class="brand-subtitle">中 国 王 朝 系 统 的 张 力 动 力 学</div>
    </div>
    <div class="preface">
      将三千余年的中国王朝视为<strong>同一个系统</strong>：每一朝都是同一组深层张力在不同历史条件下的具体展演。
      <strong>母悖论</strong>是每个时代合法性的核心矛盾；从这一点向外辐射的<strong>张力</strong>，是这个矛盾在政治、经济、军事、思想等维度的具体形态。
      点击张力查看深度分析。
    </div>
    <div class="meta-stats">
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-num">24</div>
        <div class="stat-label">Periods</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-num">160<span style="font-size:24px;">+</span></div>
        <div class="stat-label">Tensions</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-num">3000<span style="font-size:24px;">y</span></div>
        <div class="stat-label">Span</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- Meta thread bar - the over-arching paradox -->
<div class="meta-thread">
  <div class="mt-inner">
    <div class="mt-label">
      <div class="mt-label-en">Meta-Paradox · 总母悖论</div>
      <div class="mt-label-cn">贯穿三千年的根本张力</div>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-content">
      <span class="mt-pole-a">合法性的建构</span>
      <span class="mt-symbol">↔</span>
      <span class="mt-pole-b">合法性的自我消解</span>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-note">
      在夏朝被首次"写入"的代码<br>在每一代被重新执行
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<main>
  <aside class="dynasty-nav" id="nav"></aside>
  <div class="content" id="content"></div>
</main>

<!-- Modal -->
<div class="modal-overlay" id="modal-overlay">
  <div class="modal" id="modal">
    <button class="modal-close" id="modal-close">×</button>
    <div class="modal-num" id="m-num"></div>
    <div class="modal-title" id="m-title"></div>
    <div class="modal-poles">
      <div class="modal-pole a" id="m-pole-a"></div>
      <span class="modal-vs">↔</span>
      <div class="modal-pole b" id="m-pole-b"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body" id="m-body"></div>
    <div class="modal-tag" id="m-tag"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<footer>
  <div class="foot-inner">
    <div class="foot-text">
      "夏朝是中国历史上唯一一个在建立制度性悖论之前就已经存在、并亲历了那个悖论被制度化的政权。所有后来的王朝，都是在已经被夏朝制度化了的悖论结构中运行的——它们或许能够调整参数，但无法改变底层方程式。"
    </div>
    <div class="foot-mark">A System View · 系统观</div>
  </div>
</footer>

<script src="data.js"></script>
<script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>母悖论 · 中国王朝动力学</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@300;400;500;600;700;900&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --ink: #0d0f12;
    --ink-2: #15181d;
    --ink-3: #1d2128;
    --paper: #eae0cc;
    --paper-dim: #b8ad94;
    --paper-dark: #6b6452;
    --cinnabar: #c8412c;
    --cinnabar-dim: #8b2d1d;
    --jade: #6b8e7f;
    --jade-bright: #9bbfae;
    --gold: #c8a464;
    --gold-dim: #8b7340;
    --line: rgba(234,224,204,0.12);
    --line-strong: rgba(234,224,204,0.28);
    --shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  html, body {
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--paper);
    font-family: "Noto Serif SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    line-height: 1.7;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  body {
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%, rgba(200,65,44,0.08) 0%, transparent 45%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%, rgba(107,142,127,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, #0d0f12 0%, #0a0c0f 100%);
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  /* Subtle grain overlay */
  body::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 100;
    opacity: 0.4;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(234,224,204,0.025) 1px, transparent 0);
    background-size: 3px 3px;
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  }

  /* ========== HEADER ========== */
  header.masthead {
    padding: 60px 60px 40px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    position: relative;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,17,21,0.9), transparent);
  }

  .masthead-inner {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    gap: 60px;
    align-items: end;
  }

  .brand {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .brand-mark {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 12px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .brand-mark::before {
    content: '';
    display: inline-block;
    width: 28px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
  }
  .brand-title {
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    color: var(--paper);
  }
  .brand-subtitle {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  .preface {
    max-width: 540px;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.85;
    font-weight: 300;
    border-left: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    padding-left: 24px;
  }
  .preface strong {
    color: var(--paper);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .meta-stats {
    display: flex;
    gap: 32px;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }
  .stat {
    text-align: right;
  }
  .stat-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 48px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  /* ========== MAIN LAYOUT ========== */
  main {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 50px 60px 40px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    gap: 60px;
  }

  /* ========== SIDEBAR (DYNASTY NAV) ========== */
  aside.dynasty-nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 30px;
    align-self: start;
    height: calc(100vh - 60px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding-right: 8px;
  }
  aside.dynasty-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  aside.dynasty-nav::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
  aside.dynasty-nav::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--line-strong);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  .nav-label {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    padding-bottom: 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .nav-item {
    position: relative;
    padding: 12px 0 12px 22px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  }
  .nav-item:hover {
    padding-left: 28px;
  }
  .nav-item::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 8px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--paper-dark);
    transition: all 0.4s;
  }
  .nav-item:hover::before {
    width: 16px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
  }
  .nav-item.active::before {
    width: 16px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
    height: 2px;
  }
  .nav-item.active {
    padding-left: 28px;
  }
  .nav-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .nav-name {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }
  .nav-item.active .nav-name { color: var(--paper); }
  .nav-item:hover .nav-name { color: var(--paper); }
  .nav-period {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    margin-top: 2px;
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* ========== CONTENT ========== */
  .content {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* Hero block of selected dynasty */
  .dynasty-hero {
    margin-bottom: 50px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  }
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .dynasty-marker {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .dynasty-num-large {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 64px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .dynasty-period-large {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }
  .dynasty-name-large {
    font-size: 56px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--paper);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .dynasty-tagline {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--jade-bright);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--cinnabar);
    padding-left: 18px;
  }

  /* Mother Paradox - the core visualization */
  .mother-paradox {
    margin: 70px 0 60px;
    padding: 50px 0;
    position: relative;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .mp-label {
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--ink);
    padding: 0 24px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .mp-stage {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
    gap: 30px;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .mp-pole {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 30px 24px;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }
  .mp-pole-a {
    text-align: right;
  }
  .mp-pole-b {
    text-align: left;
  }
  .mp-pole-marker {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .mp-pole-text {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--paper);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .mp-pole-a .mp-pole-text { color: var(--jade-bright); }
  .mp-pole-b .mp-pole-text { color: var(--cinnabar); }

  .mp-tension {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 80px;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 200;
    line-height: 1;
    position: relative;
    animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.08); }
  }

  .mp-description {
    max-width: 820px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    font-size: 14.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.95;
    text-align: justify;
    font-weight: 300;
    text-indent: 2em;
  }
  .mp-description::first-letter {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--paper);
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  /* ========== TENSIONS GRID ========== */
  .tensions-section {
    margin-top: 70px;
  }

  .section-heading {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
    padding-bottom: 18px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .section-heading-cn {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--paper);
  }
  .section-heading-en {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .section-heading-line {
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--line);
  }
  .section-heading-count {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .tensions-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(330px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--line);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .tension-card {
    background: var(--ink);
    padding: 28px 26px;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .tension-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--cinnabar);
    transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }
  .tension-card:hover {
    background: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .tension-card:hover::before {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .tc-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 34px;
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .tc-num-label {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-style: normal;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .tc-poles {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .tc-pole {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--paper);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    line-height: 1.4;
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 14px;
  }
  .tc-pole::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 9px;
    width: 6px;
    height: 1px;
  }
  .tc-pole.a::before { background: var(--jade); }
  .tc-pole.b::before { background: var(--cinnabar); }
  .tc-pole.a { color: var(--jade-bright); }
  .tc-pole.b { color: var(--cinnabar); }
  .tc-vs {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2px 0;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  .tc-summary {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.75;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--line);
  }

  .tc-expand {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }
  .tension-card:hover .tc-expand {
    color: var(--cinnabar);
  }

  /* ========== META CONCLUSION ========== */
  .meta-conclusion {
    margin-top: 70px;
    padding: 40px 50px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(200,65,44,0.06), rgba(107,142,127,0.04));
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    position: relative;
  }
  .meta-conclusion::before {
    content: '元结论';
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px;
    left: 30px;
    background: var(--ink);
    padding: 0 18px;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--gold);
  }
  .mc-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--paper);
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .mc-text {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 1.95;
    font-weight: 300;
    text-align: justify;
  }

  /* ========== NAVIGATION CONTROLS ========== */
  .dynasty-controls {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-top: 70px;
    padding-top: 30px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .dc-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    color: var(--paper);
    padding: 14px 30px;
    font-family: "Noto Serif SC", serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 4px;
    min-width: 200px;
  }
  .dc-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--cinnabar);
    background: rgba(200,65,44,0.08);
  }
  .dc-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.3;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }
  .dc-btn-label {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .dc-btn-name {
    color: var(--paper);
  }
  .dc-btn-next { align-items: flex-end; }

  /* ========== MODAL (TENSION DETAIL) ========== */
  .modal-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(8,9,12,0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    z-index: 200;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 40px;
  }
  .modal-overlay.active {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  .modal {
    background: var(--ink-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    max-width: 760px;
    width: 100%;
    max-height: 85vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 50px 60px;
    position: relative;
    transform: translateY(20px);
    transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    box-shadow: 0 25px 60px var(--shadow);
  }
  .modal-overlay.active .modal {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--line-strong); }
  .modal-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 24px;
    right: 24px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 20px;
  }
  .modal-close:hover {
    border-color: var(--cinnabar);
    color: var(--cinnabar);
  }
  .modal-num {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .modal-title {
    font-size: 26px;
    color: var(--paper);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    line-height: 1.4;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .modal-poles {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }
  .modal-pole {
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    font-size: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }
  .modal-pole.a { color: var(--jade-bright); border-color: var(--jade); }
  .modal-pole.b { color: var(--cinnabar); border-color: var(--cinnabar-dim); }
  .modal-vs {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    font-size: 14px;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .modal-body {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--paper-dim);
    line-height: 2;
    text-align: justify;
    font-weight: 300;
  }
  .modal-body p {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    text-indent: 2em;
  }
  .modal-body p:first-child { text-indent: 0; }
  .modal-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-top: 24px;
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  /* ========== META PARADOX BAR ========== */
  .meta-thread {
    background: var(--ink-3);
    padding: 28px 60px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .mt-inner {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .mt-label {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .mt-label-en {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .mt-label-cn {
    font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--paper);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .mt-content {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 24px;
    font-size: 18px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .mt-pole-a {
    color: var(--jade-bright);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .mt-symbol {
    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
    font-size: 28px;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 200;
    animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .mt-pole-b {
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .mt-note {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    text-align: right;
    line-height: 1.5;
    max-width: 200px;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* ========== FOOTER ========== */
  footer {
    padding: 50px 60px 40px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    margin-top: 60px;
    background: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .foot-inner {
    max-width: 1500px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: end;
  }
  .foot-text {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--paper-dark);
    line-height: 1.8;
    max-width: 760px;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .foot-mark {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em;
    color: var(--cinnabar);
    text-align: right;
  }

  /* ========== RESPONSIVE ========== */
  @media (max-width: 1100px) {
    main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 40px 30px; gap: 40px; }
    aside.dynasty-nav { position: static; height: auto; max-height: none; }
    .dynasty-name-large { font-size: 40px; }
    .dynasty-num-large { font-size: 44px; }
    .mp-pole-text { font-size: 22px; }
    .mp-tension { font-size: 56px; }
    .mp-stage { gap: 16px; }
    header.masthead { padding: 40px 30px; }
    .masthead-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 30px; }
    .preface { max-width: 100%; }
    .meta-stats { justify-content: flex-start; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .dynasty-name-large { font-size: 32px; }
    .mp-stage { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .mp-pole-a, .mp-pole-b { text-align: center; }
    .mp-pole-text { font-size: 20px; }
    .meta-conclusion { padding: 30px 24px; }
    .modal { padding: 32px 24px; }
    .meta-thread { padding: 20px 24px; }
    .mt-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; text-align: center; }
    .mt-note { text-align: center; max-width: 100%; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="masthead">
  <div class="masthead-inner">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="brand-mark">Dynastic Dynamics</div>
      <div class="brand-title">母悖论</div>
      <div class="brand-subtitle">中 国 王 朝 系 统 的 张 力 动 力 学</div>
    </div>
    <div class="preface">
      将三千余年的中国王朝视为<strong>同一个系统</strong>：每一朝都是同一组深层张力在不同历史条件下的具体展演。
      <strong>母悖论</strong>是每个时代合法性的核心矛盾；从这一点向外辐射的<strong>张力</strong>，是这个矛盾在政治、经济、军事、思想等维度的具体形态。
      点击张力查看深度分析。
    </div>
    <div class="meta-stats">
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-num">24</div>
        <div class="stat-label">Periods</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-num">160<span style="font-size:24px;">+</span></div>
        <div class="stat-label">Tensions</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-num">3000<span style="font-size:24px;">y</span></div>
        <div class="stat-label">Span</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- Meta thread bar - the over-arching paradox -->
<div class="meta-thread">
  <div class="mt-inner">
    <div class="mt-label">
      <div class="mt-label-en">Meta-Paradox · 总母悖论</div>
      <div class="mt-label-cn">贯穿三千年的根本张力</div>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-content">
      <span class="mt-pole-a">合法性的建构</span>
      <span class="mt-symbol">↔</span>
      <span class="mt-pole-b">合法性的自我消解</span>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-note">
      在夏朝被首次"写入"的代码<br>在每一代被重新执行
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<main>
  <aside class="dynasty-nav" id="nav"></aside>
  <div class="content" id="content"></div>
</main>

<!-- Modal -->
<div class="modal-overlay" id="modal-overlay">
  <div class="modal" id="modal">
    <button class="modal-close" id="modal-close">×</button>
    <div class="modal-num" id="m-num"></div>
    <div class="modal-title" id="m-title"></div>
    <div class="modal-poles">
      <div class="modal-pole a" id="m-pole-a"></div>
      <span class="modal-vs">↔</span>
      <div class="modal-pole b" id="m-pole-b"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body" id="m-body"></div>
    <div class="modal-tag" id="m-tag"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<footer>
  <div class="foot-inner">
    <div class="foot-text">
      "夏朝是中国历史上唯一一个在建立制度性悖论之前就已经存在、并亲历了那个悖论被制度化的政权。所有后来的王朝，都是在已经被夏朝制度化了的悖论结构中运行的——它们或许能够调整参数，但无法改变底层方程式。"
    </div>
    <div class="foot-mark">A System View · 系统观</div>
  </div>
</footer>

<script src="data.js"></script>
<script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

每个系统都有一个 母悖论 (mother paradox)，它是该系统所有具体张力的总根源。具体张力则是母悖论在不同维度上的变奏与展开。

从左侧选择任一系统，你将看到它的母悖论、所有具体张力、以及连接所有张力的元结论。点击任一张力卡片可以阅读详细分析。

建议从「宗教思想」中的基督教或佛教开始，那里展示了悖论分析方法最完整的形态。

`; }
