files.content:
"""
Build Alphabet (GOOGL) Greenwald 3-Model valuation workbook.
Designed to be opened in Claude for Excel for collaborative completion.
"""

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.comments import Comment
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

# Color palette per xlsx skill conventions
BLUE = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='0000FF')          # hardcoded inputs
BLACK = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='000000')         # formulas
GREEN = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='008000')         # cross-sheet links
RED = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='FF0000')           # external links
BOLD = Font(name='Arial', size=10, bold=True, color='000000')
BOLD_WHITE = Font(name='Arial', size=11, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
HEADER_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=12, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
TITLE_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=14, bold=True, color='000000')

YELLOW = PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFFF00')         # needs attention
NAVY = PatternFill('solid', start_color='1F3864')           # title bar
LIGHT_BLUE = PatternFill('solid', start_color='D9E1F2')     # section header
LIGHT_GRAY = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F2F2F2')     # subtotal
GREEN_FILL = PatternFill('solid', start_color='C6EFCE')     # result cells

thin = Side(border_style='thin', color='999999')
BORDER = Border(top=thin, bottom=thin, left=thin, right=thin)
BOTTOM = Border(bottom=thin)
TOP_BOTTOM = Border(top=thin, bottom=Side(border_style='double', color='000000'))

CENTER = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
LEFT = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
RIGHT = Alignment(horizontal='right', vertical='center')

# Number formats
NUM = '_($* #,##0_);_($* (#,##0);_($* "-"_);_(@_)'
PCT = '0.0%;(0.0%);"-"'
MULT = '0.00"x"'
YEAR = '0'

wb = Workbook()

# =============================================================================
# SHEET 1: INSTRUCTIONS & PROMPT LIBRARY
# =============================================================================
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "0_Instructions"

ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 4
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 32
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 110

ws['B2'] = "GREENWALD 3-MODEL VALUATION — ALPHABET (GOOGL)"
ws['B2'].font = TITLE_FONT
ws.merge_cells('B2:C2')

ws['B3'] = "Workbook designed for use with Claude for Excel sidebar"
ws['B3'].font = Font(name='Arial', size=10, italic=True, color='666666')
ws.merge_cells('B3:C3')

# Method overview
ws['B5'] = "METHOD"
ws['B5'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws['B5'].fill = NAVY
ws['C5'] = "DESCRIPTION"
ws['C5'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws['C5'].fill = NAVY

method_rows = [
    ("Model 1: Asset Reproduction Value",
     "Cost a new entrant would incur to recreate Alphabet's productive assets. Most reliable when the industry has no franchise. Adjust each asset class from book to reproduction cost; capitalize hidden intangibles (R&D, brand, customer base)."),
    ("Model 2: Earnings Power Value (EPV)",
     "Value of current sustainable earnings, assuming zero growth: EPV = Adjusted Earnings / WACC. The KEY adjustments are (a) normalize margins across cycle, (b) replace D&A with true maintenance CapEx, (c) strip out one-time items, (d) normalize tax."),
    ("Model 3: Value of Growth",
     "ONLY counted if franchise exists (EPV >> Asset Value AND ROIC > WACC). Otherwise growth destroys value. Greenwald's franchise-based growth value uses the gap between ROIC and WACC, not a DCF terminal value."),
    ("Decision rule",
     "Take the LOWEST well-supported value. Greenwald is deliberately conservative: any number requiring optimistic assumptions about competitive durability is rejected. Margin of safety is computed against the lowest defensible value."),
]
row = 6
for label, desc in method_rows:
    ws[f'B{row}'] = label
    ws[f'B{row}'].font = BOLD
    ws[f'B{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws[f'B{row}'].fill = LIGHT_BLUE
    ws[f'C{row}'] = desc
    ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 60
    row += 1

# Workflow
row += 1
ws[f'B{row}'] = "STEP-BY-STEP WORKFLOW (use the Claude for Excel sidebar)"
ws[f'B{row}'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws[f'B{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws[f'C{row}'] = ""
ws[f'C{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws.merge_cells(f'B{row}:C{row}')
row += 1

workflow = [
    ("Step 0", "Open this workbook in Excel. Open the Claude sidebar (Home → Add-ins → Claude). In Settings, enable 'Work across files'."),
    ("Step 1", "Go to tab 1_Raw_Data. Paste the prompt 'P1' below into the Claude sidebar. Claude will populate yellow cells from Alphabet's 10-K filings."),
    ("Step 2", "Go to tab 2_Asset_Value. Paste prompt 'P2' — Claude will fill in adjustments for each asset class, including hidden intangibles."),
    ("Step 3", "Go to tab 3_EPV. Paste prompt 'P3' — Claude computes normalized margins, maintenance CapEx, and WACC."),
    ("Step 4", "Go to tab 4_Growth_Value. Paste prompt 'P4' — Claude runs the franchise test BEFORE computing any growth value."),
    ("Step 5", "Go to tab 5_Summary. Paste prompt 'P5' — Claude triangulates the three values and computes margin of safety vs current price."),
    ("Step 6", "Audit. Paste prompt 'P6' — Claude critiques its own assumptions and flags optimistic estimates. THIS STEP IS NON-OPTIONAL for Greenwald-style discipline."),
]
for label, desc in workflow:
    ws[f'B{row}'] = label
    ws[f'B{row}'].font = BOLD
    ws[f'B{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top')
    ws[f'C{row}'] = desc
    ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 30
    row += 1

# Prompt library
row += 2
ws[f'B{row}'] = "PROMPT LIBRARY (copy verbatim into Claude for Excel sidebar)"
ws[f'B{row}'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws[f'B{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws[f'C{row}'] = ""
ws[f'C{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws.merge_cells(f'B{row}:C{row}')
row += 1

prompts = [
    ("P1 — Data Pull",

    ("SENSITIVITY (per-share EPV)", None, "", None),
    ("WACC −200bp / Margin +300bp", "0", '"$"#,##0.00', "Filled by Claude as scenario."),
    ("WACC base / Margin base", "=C45", '"$"#,##0.00', "Base case."),
    ("WACC +200bp / Margin −300bp", "0", '"$"#,##0.00', "Filled by Claude as scenario."),
]

row = 6
for item, val, fmt, note in epv_lines:
    if item == "":
        row += 1
        continue
    cell_b = ws.cell(row=row, column=2, value=item)
    if item.startswith("STEP") or item == "SENSITIVITY (per-share EPV)":
        cell_b.font = BOLD
        cell_b.fill = LIGHT_BLUE
        for c in range(3, 5):
            ws.cell(row=row, column=c).fill = LIGHT_BLUE
    else:
        cell_c = ws.cell(row=row, column=3)
        if isinstance(val, str) and val.startswith("="):
            cell_c.value = val
            cell_c.font = BLACK if not val.startswith("='") else GREEN
        elif val is not None:
            try:
                cell_c.value = float(val)
                cell_c.font = BLUE
                cell_c.fill = YELLOW
            except ValueError:
                cell_c.value = val
        if fmt:
            cell_c.number_format = fmt
        if note:
            ws.cell(row=row, column=4, value=note).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
            ws.cell(row=row, column=4).font = Font(name='Arial', size=9, color='666666')
        # Highlight key result
        if item == "EPV per Share":
            cell_c.fill = GREEN_FILL
            cell_c.font = BOLD
            cell_c.border = TOP_BOTTOM
    if note and ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value:
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 22
    row += 1

ws.freeze_panes = 'C6'

# =============================================================================
# SHEET 5: GROWTH VALUE WITH FRANCHISE TEST
# =============================================================================
ws = wb.create_sheet("4_Growth_Value")
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 4
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 44
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 18
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 60

ws['B2'] = "MODEL 3: VALUE OF GROWTH (with mandatory franchise test)"
ws['B2'].font = TITLE_FONT
ws.merge_cells('B2:D2')
ws['B3'] = "Growth only creates value INSIDE a franchise. Test first; calculate second."
ws['B3'].font = Font(name='Arial', size=10, italic=True, color='666666')
ws.merge_cells('B3:D3')

ws['B5'] = "Item"
ws['C5'] = "Value"
ws['D5'] = "Evidence (filled by Claude)"
for col in range(2, 5):
    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).font = HEADER_FONT
    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).fill = NAVY
    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).alignment = CENTER

growth_lines = [
    ("PART A — FRANCHISE TEST (must pass all 3)", None, "", None),
    ("Test 1: EPV / Asset Reproduction Value", "=IFERROR('3_EPV'!C43/'2_Asset_Value'!E37,0)", MULT, "Need ratio >> 1 (Greenwald says >1.5x is strong evidence of franchise)."),
    ("Test 1 result (PASS if > 1.5x)", "=IF(C7>1.5,\"PASS\",\"FAIL\")", None, ""),
    ("", None, "", None),
    ("Test 2: ROIC > WACC for 5+ years?", "PASS/FAIL", None, "Claude verifies from historical ROIC. Compute ROIC = NOPAT / Invested Capital."),
    ("Most recent ROIC", "0", PCT, "FY2025 ROIC."),
    ("5-year median ROIC", "0", PCT, "Greenwald wants durable, not peak."),
    ("WACC (from EPV sheet)", "='3_EPV'!C36", PCT, ""),
    ("ROIC − WACC spread", "=C11-C12", PCT, "Must be persistently positive."),
    ("", None, "", None),
    ("Test 3: Identifiable structural moat?", "Y/N", None, "Claude lists evidence: Search network effects, Android switching costs, Cloud scale."),
    ("", None, "", None),
    ("FRANCHISE TEST OVERALL", "=IF(AND(C7>1.5,C13>0),\"PROCEED with growth value\",\"STOP — Growth value = 0\")", None, ""),
    ("", None, "", None),
    ("PART B — GROWTH VALUE (only if franchise test passes)", None, "", None),
    ("Sustainable growth rate g (capped at 3%)", "0.03", PCT, "= retention × ROIC, capped at long-run GDP."),
    ("WACC", "='3_EPV'!C36", PCT, ""),
    ("ROIC (5yr median)", "=C11", PCT, ""),
    ("Adjusted NOPAT (from EPV sheet)", "='3_EPV'!C26", NUM, ""),
    ("", None, "", None),
    ("Growth multiplier = g / (WACC − g)", "=IFERROR(C17/(C18-C17),0)", MULT, ""),
    ("Franchise margin = (ROIC − WACC) / ROIC", "=IFERROR((C19-C18)/C19,0)", PCT, "Fraction of incremental investment that creates value."),
    ("", None, "", None),
    ("GROWTH VALUE", "=IF(C14=\"STOP — Growth value = 0\",0,C20*C22*C23)", NUM, "Only positive if franchise test passed."),
    ("EPV (from EPV sheet)", "='3_EPV'!C40", NUM, "Operating EPV."),
    ("Total Enterprise Value (EPV + Growth Value)", "=C25+C26", NUM, ""),
    ("Add: Excess Cash", "='3_EPV'!C41", NUM, ""),
    ("Less: Total Debt", "='3_EPV'!C42", NUM, ""),
    ("Equity Value (with Growth)", "=C27+C28-C29", NUM, ""),
    ("Diluted Shares (mm)", "='1_Raw_Data'!M52", NUM, ""),
    ("Value per Share (with Growth)", "=IFERROR(C30/C31,\"fill shares\")", '"$"#,##0.00', "← Key result."),
]

row = 6
for item, val, fmt, note in growth_lines:
    if item == "":
        row += 1
        continue
    cell_b = ws.cell(row=row, column=2, value=item)
    if item.startswith("PART") or item == "FRANCHISE TEST OVERALL" or item == "GROWTH VALUE":
        cell_b.font = BOLD
        cell_b.fill = LIGHT_BLUE
        for c in range(3, 5):
            ws.cell(row=row, column=c).fill = LIGHT_BLUE
    else:
        cell_c = ws.cell(row=row, column=3)
        if isinstance(val, str) and val.startswith("="):
            cell_c.value = val
            cell_c.font = BLACK if not val.startswith("='") else GREEN
        elif val is not None:
            try:
                cell_c.value = float(val)
                cell_c.font = BLUE
                cell_c.fill = YELLOW
            except ValueError:
                cell_c.value = val
                cell_c.font = BLUE
                cell_c.fill = YELLOW
        if fmt:
            cell_c.number_format = fmt
        if note:
            ws.cell(row=row, column=4, value=note).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
            ws.cell(row=row, column=4).font = Font(name='Arial', size=9, color='666666')
        if item == "Value per Share (with Growth)":
            cell_c.fill = GREEN_FILL
            cell_c.font = BOLD
            cell_c.border = TOP_BOTTOM
    if note:
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 22
    row += 1

ws.freeze_panes = 'C6'

# =============================================================================
# SHEET 6: SUMMARY
# =============================================================================
ws = wb.create_sheet("5_Summary")
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 4
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 42
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 20
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 50

ws['B2'] = "SUMMARY — TRIANGULATION & MARGIN OF SAFETY"
ws['B2'].font = TITLE_FONT
ws.merge_cells('B2:D2')

ws['B5'] = "Valuation Method"
ws['C5'] = "Per-Share Value"
ws['D5'] = "Interpretation"
for col in range(2, 5):
    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).font = HEADER_FONT
    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).fill = NAVY
    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).alignment = CENTER

summary_lines = [
    ("Model 1: Asset Reproduction Value", "='2_Asset_Value'!E38", "Floor value. What a new entrant would pay."),
    ("Model 2: Earnings Power Value (EPV)", "='3_EPV'!C45", "Value of current earnings with no growth."),
    ("Model 3: Value w/ Growth (if franchise)", "='4_Growth_Value'!C32", "Adds franchise growth value if test passes."),
    ("", None, ""),
    ("LOWEST defensible value (Greenwald rule)", "=MIN(C6,C7)", "Use the lower of Asset and EPV. Growth is a free option."),
    ("Current GOOGL Stock Price", "0", "Fill with current close (web search via Claude)."),
    ("Market Cap ($mm)", "=C11*'1_Raw_Data'!M52", ""),
    ("", None, ""),
    ("Margin vs Asset Value", "=IFERROR((C6-C11)/C11,0)", "Positive = stock below asset value."),
    ("Margin vs EPV", "=IFERROR((C7-C11)/C11,0)", "Positive = stock below EPV."),
    ("Margin vs LOWEST", "=IFERROR((C10-C11)/C11,0)", "Greenwald wants ≥ 30% positive margin to buy."),
    ("", None, ""),
    ("Target buy price (30% margin of safety)", "=C10*0.7", "Price at which to initiate position."),
    ("", None, ""),
    ("DECISION", "FILL: BUY / HOLD / PASS", "Based on margin vs lowest defensible value."),
]

row = 6
for item, val, note in summary_lines:
    if item == "":
        row += 1
        continue
    cell_b = ws.cell(row=row, column=2, value=item)
    cell_c = ws.cell(row=row, column=3)
    if isinstance(val, str) and val.startswith("="):
        cell_c.value = val
        cell_c.font = GREEN if "'" in val else BLACK
        cell_c.number_format = '"$"#,##0.00' if "Margin" not in item and "Mkt Cap" not in item.replace("Market", "Mkt") and "Market Cap" not in item else (NUM if "Cap" in item else PCT)
        if "Margin" in item:
            cell_c.number_format = PCT
        if "Market Cap" in item:
            cell_c.number_format = NUM
    elif val is not None:
        try:
            cell_c.value = float(val)
            cell_c.font = BLUE
            cell_c.fill = YELLOW
            cell_c.number_format = '"$"#,##0.00'
        except ValueError:
            cell_c.value = val
            cell_c.font = BLUE
            cell_c.fill = YELLOW
    if note:
        ws.cell(row=row, column=4, value=note).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
        ws.cell(row=row, column=4).font = Font(name='Arial', size=9, color='666666')
    if item == "LOWEST defensible value (Greenwald rule)":
        cell_c.fill = GREEN_FILL
        cell_c.font = BOLD
    if item == "Target buy price (30% margin of safety)":
        cell_c.fill = GREEN_FILL
        cell_c.font = BOLD
    if item == "DECISION":
        cell_b.font = BOLD
        cell_b.fill = LIGHT_BLUE
        cell_c.fill = YELLOW
    row += 1

ws.freeze_panes = 'C6'

# Save
output_path = '/home/claude/work/GOOGL_Greenwald_3Model.xlsx'
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved to: {output_path}")

versions.content:
"""
Build Alphabet (GOOGL) Greenwald 3-Model valuation workbook.
Designed to be opened in Claude for Excel for collaborative completion.
"""

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.comments import Comment
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

# Color palette per xlsx skill conventions
BLUE = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='0000FF')          # hardcoded inputs
BLACK = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='000000')         # formulas
GREEN = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='008000')         # cross-sheet links
RED = Font(name='Arial', size=10, color='FF0000')           # external links
BOLD = Font(name='Arial', size=10, bold=True, color='000000')
BOLD_WHITE = Font(name='Arial', size=11, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
HEADER_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=12, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
TITLE_FONT = Font(name='Arial', size=14, bold=True, color='000000')

YELLOW = PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFFF00')         # needs attention
NAVY = PatternFill('solid', start_color='1F3864')           # title bar
LIGHT_BLUE = PatternFill('solid', start_color='D9E1F2')     # section header
LIGHT_GRAY = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F2F2F2')     # subtotal
GREEN_FILL = PatternFill('solid', start_color='C6EFCE')     # result cells

thin = Side(border_style='thin', color='999999')
BORDER = Border(top=thin, bottom=thin, left=thin, right=thin)
BOTTOM = Border(bottom=thin)
TOP_BOTTOM = Border(top=thin, bottom=Side(border_style='double', color='000000'))

CENTER = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
LEFT = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
RIGHT = Alignment(horizontal='right', vertical='center')

# Number formats
NUM = '_($* #,##0_);_($* (#,##0);_($* "-"_);_(@_)'
PCT = '0.0%;(0.0%);"-"'
MULT = '0.00"x"'
YEAR = '0'

wb = Workbook()

# =============================================================================
# SHEET 1: INSTRUCTIONS & PROMPT LIBRARY
# =============================================================================
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "0_Instructions"

ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 4
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 32
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 110

ws['B2'] = "GREENWALD 3-MODEL VALUATION — ALPHABET (GOOGL)"
ws['B2'].font = TITLE_FONT
ws.merge_cells('B2:C2')

ws['B3'] = "Workbook designed for use with Claude for Excel sidebar"
ws['B3'].font = Font(name='Arial', size=10, italic=True, color='666666')
ws.merge_cells('B3:C3')

# Method overview
ws['B5'] = "METHOD"
ws['B5'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws['B5'].fill = NAVY
ws['C5'] = "DESCRIPTION"
ws['C5'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws['C5'].fill = NAVY

method_rows = [
    ("Model 1: Asset Reproduction Value",
     "Cost a new entrant would incur to recreate Alphabet's productive assets. Most reliable when the industry has no franchise. Adjust each asset class from book to reproduction cost; capitalize hidden intangibles (R&D, brand, customer base)."),
    ("Model 2: Earnings Power Value (EPV)",
     "Value of current sustainable earnings, assuming zero growth: EPV = Adjusted Earnings / WACC. The KEY adjustments are (a) normalize margins across cycle, (b) replace D&A with true maintenance CapEx, (c) strip out one-time items, (d) normalize tax."),
    ("Model 3: Value of Growth",
     "ONLY counted if franchise exists (EPV >> Asset Value AND ROIC > WACC). Otherwise growth destroys value. Greenwald's franchise-based growth value uses the gap between ROIC and WACC, not a DCF terminal value."),
    ("Decision rule",
     "Take the LOWEST well-supported value. Greenwald is deliberately conservative: any number requiring optimistic assumptions about competitive durability is rejected. Margin of safety is computed against the lowest defensible value."),
]
row = 6
for label, desc in method_rows:
    ws[f'B{row}'] = label
    ws[f'B{row}'].font = BOLD
    ws[f'B{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws[f'B{row}'].fill = LIGHT_BLUE
    ws[f'C{row}'] = desc
    ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 60
    row += 1

# Workflow
row += 1
ws[f'B{row}'] = "STEP-BY-STEP WORKFLOW (use the Claude for Excel sidebar)"
ws[f'B{row}'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws[f'B{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws[f'C{row}'] = ""
ws[f'C{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws.merge_cells(f'B{row}:C{row}')
row += 1

workflow = [
    ("Step 0", "Open this workbook in Excel. Open the Claude sidebar (Home → Add-ins → Claude). In Settings, enable 'Work across files'."),
    ("Step 1", "Go to tab 1_Raw_Data. Paste the prompt 'P1' below into the Claude sidebar. Claude will populate yellow cells from Alphabet's 10-K filings."),
    ("Step 2", "Go to tab 2_Asset_Value. Paste prompt 'P2' — Claude will fill in adjustments for each asset class, including hidden intangibles."),
    ("Step 3", "Go to tab 3_EPV. Paste prompt 'P3' — Claude computes normalized margins, maintenance CapEx, and WACC."),
    ("Step 4", "Go to tab 4_Growth_Value. Paste prompt 'P4' — Claude runs the franchise test BEFORE computing any growth value."),
    ("Step 5", "Go to tab 5_Summary. Paste prompt 'P5' — Claude triangulates the three values and computes margin of safety vs current price."),
    ("Step 6", "Audit. Paste prompt 'P6' — Claude critiques its own assumptions and flags optimistic estimates. THIS STEP IS NON-OPTIONAL for Greenwald-style discipline."),
]
for label, desc in workflow:
    ws[f'B{row}'] = label
    ws[f'B{row}'].font = BOLD
    ws[f'B{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top')
    ws[f'C{row}'] = desc
    ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 30
    row += 1

# Prompt library
row += 2
ws[f'B{row}'] = "PROMPT LIBRARY (copy verbatim into Claude for Excel sidebar)"
ws[f'B{row}'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws[f'B{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws[f'C{row}'] = ""
ws[f'C{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws.merge_cells(f'B{row}:C{row}')
row += 1

prompts = [
    ("P1 — Data Pull",
     "You are populating the '1_Raw_Data' tab. For Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL), fetch the last 10 fiscal years (FY2016–FY2025) of: Revenue, Operating Income, Net Income, R&D Expense, SG&A Expense, Depreciation & Amortization, Capital Expenditures, Total Current Assets, Inventory, PP&E Gross, PP&E Net, Goodwill, Intangibles, Total Assets, Accounts Payable, Deferred Revenue, Total Debt, Cash & Marketable Securities, Shareholders' Equity, Diluted Shares Outstanding. Fill the yellow cells. For each datapoint cite the 10-K page or press release URL in the Source column. Do NOT round — use $ millions exactly as reported. Where two numbers conflict between 10-K and press release, prefer the 10-K."),

    ("P2 — Asset Reproduction",
     "You are populating the '2_Asset_Value' tab using data from '1_Raw_Data'. For each asset class apply Greenwald's adjustment rules: (1) Cash & marketable securities — at face value. (2) Receivables — apply a 5–10% bad-debt haircut and explain. (3) Inventory — Alphabet has minimal inventory, take at book. (4) PP&E — use REPLACEMENT cost, not book; for data centers, GPUs, and network gear, replacement cost typically exceeds depreciated book by 20–40% due to AI infrastructure inflation; cite your assumption. (5) Goodwill — DELETE; replace with reproduction cost of acquired businesses. (6) Hidden intangibles: capitalize 3 years of R&D ($45–50B/yr), 2 years of sales & marketing for customer acquisition, and an estimated brand reproduction cost (use a comparable advertising spend benchmark and explain). (7) Subtract spontaneous liabilities (accounts payable, accrued expenses, deferred revenue). Show every adjustment with its rationale in column F. Compute Net Asset Reproduction Value and per-share value."),

    ("P3 — Earnings Power Value",
     "You are populating the '3_EPV' tab. Steps: (1) Pull 10yr operating margin history from '1_Raw_Data' and compute the median — that is the normalized margin (NOT the most recent, which may be cyclically inflated by AI ad demand). (2) Apply normalized margin to current TTM revenue to get normalized EBIT. (3) Strip one-time items (EC fines, legal settlements, restructuring) — list each and the year. (4) Maintenance CapEx: use the Greenwald formula MaintCapEx = Total CapEx − (avg PP&E/Sales ratio × ΔSales for the year). Compute this for each of the last 5 years and take the average. WARN if maintenance CapEx is greater than D&A — that means depreciation is understating real economic depreciation. (5) Tax-adjust at normalized rate (~21% US statutory + state, unless company-specific). (6) Compute WACC using cost of equity (CAPM: Rf=current 10yr Treasury, ERP=5.0%, beta=Alphabet's 5yr beta) and after-tax cost of debt; weight by market values. (7) EPV = Adjusted Earnings / WACC. (8) Add excess cash (cash minus operating cash need of ~2% of sales), subtract total debt. Show per-share. Build a sensitivity table for WACC ±200bp and margin ±300bp."),

    ("P4 — Growth Value with Franchise Test",
     "You are populating the '4_Growth_Value' tab. FIRST, run the franchise test: (a) Is EPV materially greater than Asset Reproduction Value? Report the ratio. (b) Has Alphabet's ROIC exceeded WACC for at least 5 consecutive years? Compute ROIC = NOPAT / (Total Assets − Non-interest-bearing current liabilities). (c) Is there an identifiable structural moat (network effects in Search, switching costs in Android/Workspace, scale economies in Cloud)? Answer Y/N with evidence for each. ONLY IF all three pass, compute growth value using Greenwald's franchise growth formula: Growth Value = Earnings × (g/(WACC − g)) × ((ROIC − WACC)/ROIC), where g is sustainable growth = retention ratio × ROIC, capped at long-run GDP growth (3%). If franchise test fails, write 'Growth value = 0' and explain why."),

    ("P5 — Triangulation & Margin of Safety",
     "You are populating the '5_Summary' tab. Pull per-share values from the three model tabs into the summary table. Add current GOOGL stock price (search the web for today's close). Compute margin of safety vs each model. Apply Greenwald's decision rule: the value-investing thesis requires the stock to trade BELOW the LOWEST of (Asset Value, EPV), with growth value treated as a free option. State explicitly: BUY / HOLD / PASS, and the price at which you would buy with a 30% margin of safety."),

    ("P6 — Self-Audit (mandatory)",
     "Critique your own work in the previous five tabs. Specifically: (1) List every assumption where you chose the optimistic end of a defensible range. (2) Identify any line item where the value depends on Alphabet's competitive position staying intact for >10 years — Greenwald explicitly discounts such assumptions. (3) Re-run the EPV and Growth Value with the pessimistic version of each assumption. (4) Output the spread between optimistic and pessimistic intrinsic value per share. If the spread is greater than 50%, declare the valuation 'too uncertain to act on' per Greenwald's epistemic standard."),
]

for label, prompt in prompts:
    ws[f'B{row}'] = label
    ws[f'B{row}'].font = BOLD
    ws[f'B{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws[f'B{row}'].fill = LIGHT_BLUE
    ws[f'C{row}'] = prompt
    ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
    ws[f'C{row}'].border = BORDER
    ws[f'B{row}'].border = BORDER
    # Approximate row height based on prompt length
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = max(60, min(220, len(prompt) // 2))
    row += 1

# Color legend
row += 2
ws[f'B{row}'] = "COLOR & FILL LEGEND"
ws[f'B{row}'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws[f'B{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws[f'C{row}'] = ""
ws[f'C{row}'].fill = NAVY
ws.merge_cells(f'B{row}:C{row}')
row += 1
legend = [
    ("Blue text", "Hardcoded input (a number you or Claude type in)", BLUE, None),
    ("Black text", "Formula calculated by Excel", BLACK, None),
    ("Green text", "Link to another sheet in this workbook", GREEN, None),
    ("Red text", "Link to external file or data source", RED, None),
    ("Yellow fill", "Needs to be filled in — use the matching prompt", None, YELLOW),
    ("Green fill", "Key result cell — read off the per-share value here", None, GREEN_FILL),
]
for label, desc, fnt, fill in legend:
    ws[f'B{row}'] = label
    if fnt:
        ws[f'B{row}'].font = fnt
    if fill:
        ws[f'B{row}'].fill = fill
    ws[f'C{row}'] = desc
    row += 1

# =============================================================================
# SHEET 2: RAW DATA
# =============================================================================
ws = wb.create_sheet("1_Raw_Data")
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 4
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 40
years = list(range(2016, 2026))
for i, _ in enumerate(years):
    col = get_column_letter(3 + i)
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(3 + len(years))].width = 50  # source column

ws['B2'] = "ALPHABET INC. — RAW FINANCIAL DATA ($ millions unless noted)"
ws['B2'].font = TITLE_FONT
ws.merge_cells(f'B2:{get_column_letter(3 + len(years))}2')

# Header row
ws['B4'] = "Line Item"
ws['B4'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws['B4'].fill = NAVY
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    cell = ws.cell(row=4, column=3 + i, value=f"FY{yr}")
    cell.font = HEADER_FONT
    cell.fill = NAVY
    cell.alignment = CENTER
src_col = get_column_letter(3 + len(years))
ws[f'{src_col}4'] = "Source / Note"
ws[f'{src_col}4'].font = HEADER_FONT
ws[f'{src_col}4'].fill = NAVY

# Income statement section
sections = [
    ("INCOME STATEMENT", [

            cell_c.border = TOP_BOTTOM
    if note:

    row += 1

ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 42
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 20
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 50

ws['B2'].font = TITLE_FONT
ws.merge_cells('B2:D2')

ws['B5'] = "Valuation Method"
ws['C5'] = "Per-Share Value"
ws['D5'] = "Interpretation"
for col in range(2, 5):

    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).fill = NAVY
    ws.cell(row=5, column=col).alignment = CENTER

    ("Model 1: Asset Reproduction Value", "='2_Asset_Value'!E38", "Floor value. What a new entrant would pay."),
    ("Model 2: Earnings Power Value (EPV)", "='3_EPV'!C45", "Value of current earnings with no growth."),
    ("Model 3: Value w/ Growth (if franchise)", "='4_Growth_Value'!C32", "Adds franchise growth value if test passes."),
    ("", None, ""),
    ("LOWEST defensible value (Greenwald rule)", "=MIN(C6,C7)", "Use the lower of Asset and EPV. Growth is a free option."),

Options · Black-Scholes · 实时联动

期权希腊字母
变动趋势聚合视图

在同一张图上观察 Call 与 Put 的 Delta、Gamma、Vega、Theta、IV 如何随股价穿越 OTM → ATM → ITM 而演变。

行权价 Strike 100
基准波动率 σ 25%
到期天数 DTE 30 天
无风险利率 r 5.0%
偏斜强度 Skew 0.50
Call · 看涨
Put · 看跌
ATM 分界线 (S = K)
每张图顶部均标注：
Call · OTM/ATM/ITM
Put · OTM/ATM/ITM
Delta · 方向敏感度
Δ = ∂V/∂S

Call Δ ∈ [0,1]，Put Δ ∈ [-1,0]。ATM 处 Call ≈ +0.5、Put ≈ -0.5。

Call @ S=K—
Put @ S=K—
Gamma · 凸性
Γ = ∂²V/∂S²

Call 与 Put 的 Gamma 完全相同，在 ATM 附近达到峰值。

峰值 @ ATM—
深度 ITM/OTM→ 0
Vega · 波动率敏感度
ν = ∂V/∂σ

Call 与 Put 的 Vega 完全相同，ATM 处最高，远离 ATM 衰减。

峰值 @ ATM—
单位per 1% σ
Theta · 时间损耗
Θ = ∂V/∂t

每日时间衰减。ATM 衰减最快，深度 OTM/ITM 衰减放缓。

Call @ S=K—
Put @ S=K—
Implied Volatility · 隐含波动率偏斜
σ_IV (m), m = ln(S/K)

注：根据 Put-Call Parity，同一行权价的 Call 与 Put 共享同一 IV — 因此两条曲线完全重合。此图模拟股票市场常见的偏斜结构：OTM Put（左侧）IV 升高，深度 OTM Call（右侧）轻微回升，形成"波动率微笑/偏斜"。

基准 σ @ ATM—
深度 OTM Put 偏斜—
深度 OTM Call 偏斜—

区域速读

同一股价 S 对 Call 与 Put 含义相反
S < K
Call · OTM Put · ITM

股价低于行权价时：买 Call 是赌反弹（虚值），买 Put 已锁定收益（实值）。

S ≈ K
Call · ATM Put · ATM

平值附近：Gamma、Vega、Theta 同时达到峰值，权利金对 S 的小幅变动最敏感。

S > K
Call · ITM Put · OTM

股价高于行权价时：买 Call 已锁定收益（实值），买 Put 是赌回调（虚值）。

Black-Scholes-Merton model · 假设：欧式期权、无股息、对数正态分布、常数 r 与 σ。

波动率偏斜采用二次 log-moneyness 模型：σ(m) = σ₀ · (1 − k·m + 0.6·k·m²)，仅作示意。

本工具仅供教育用途，不构成投资建议。

files.name: README.md
files.content:
# 期权希腊字母可视化 · Options Greeks Visualizer

一个交互式的期权希腊字母（Delta、Gamma、Vega、Theta、IV）可视化工具，可在同一页面横向对比 Call 与 Put 在 OTM → ATM → ITM 三个区域随股价变动的趋势。

纯静态 HTML 单文件，无构建步骤，可直接部署到 GitHub Pages。

## ✨ 特性

- **五个 Greeks 一屏聚合**：Delta、Gamma、Vega、Theta、IV 同时呈现，方便横向对比。
- **实时联动**：拖动滑块即时更新所有图表（行权价、波动率、到期天数、无风险利率、偏斜强度）。
- **Call vs Put 同图叠加**：用暖琥珀（Call）与冷青绿（Put）区分，配合虚线区别重合曲线（Gamma、Vega）。
- **ATM 参考线**：每张图都有一条虚线标记 S = K 的位置，OTM/ATM/ITM 区域一目了然。
- **IV 波动率偏斜**：用 log-moneyness 二次模型模拟真实市场偏斜（OTM Put 高 IV、深度 OTM Call 微回升），并在界面明确说明 Put-Call Parity 使两曲线重合。
- **Black-Scholes-Merton 模型**：使用 Abramowitz-Stegun 7.1.26 近似计算正态分布 CDF，精度约 7.5×10⁻⁸。

## 🚀 GitHub Pages 部署步骤

### 方法 1：通过 GitHub 网页界面（最简单）

1. 在 GitHub 上新建一个仓库，例如 `options-greeks-viz`，设为 **Public**。
2. 把 `index.html` 上传到仓库根目录（点 "Add file" → "Upload files"）。
3. 进入仓库 **Settings → Pages**。
4. 在 "Build and deployment" 下：
   - **Source** 选 `Deploy from a branch`
   - **Branch** 选 `main`（或 `master`），目录选 `/ (root)`
   - 点 **Save**
5. 等待约 1 分钟，刷新页面，顶部会显示访问链接：
   ```
   https://<你的用户名>.github.io/options-greeks-viz/
   ```

### 方法 2：通过命令行

```bash
# 1. 初始化本地仓库
git init
git add index.html README.md
git commit -m "Initial commit: options Greeks visualizer"

# 2. 关联远程仓库（先在 GitHub 上创建空仓库）
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/<你的用户名>/options-greeks-viz.git
git push -u origin main

# 3. 在仓库 Settings → Pages 启用 Pages，按方法 1 的步骤 3-5 操作
```

### 方法 3：作为个人主页

如果想把它作为 `https://<用户名>.github.io/` 的主页，仓库名必须是 `<用户名>.github.io`，把 `index.html` 放到根目录即可。

## 📐 模型说明

### Black-Scholes-Merton 假设

- 欧式期权（仅到期日可行权）
- 标的资产服从几何布朗运动（对数正态分布）
- 无股息（如需可扩展为 r → r - q）
- 无风险利率与波动率为常数
- 无交易成本与税费

### 希腊字母公式

| Greek | 公式 |
|-------|------|
| Call Δ | N(d₁) |
| Put Δ | N(d₁) − 1 |
| Γ | n(d₁) / (S·σ·√T) |
| ν | S·n(d₁)·√T / 100 |
| Call Θ | [−S·n(d₁)·σ/(2√T) − r·K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂)] / 365 |
| Put Θ | [−S·n(d₁)·σ/(2√T) + r·K·e^(−rT)·N(−d₂)] / 365 |

其中 d₁ = [ln(S/K) + (r + σ²/2)·T] / (σ·√T)，d₂ = d₁ − σ·√T。

### 波动率偏斜模型

为了让 IV 在图上有可观察的变化趋势（否则 BS 模型中 IV 是输入常数），本工具用一个简单的二次 log-moneyness 模型模拟股票市场常见的偏斜：

```
σ(m) = σ₀ · (1 − k·m + 0.6·k·m²)，  m = ln(S/K)
```

- 当 S < K（OTM Put / ITM Call）：m < 0，σ 升高 → 反映市场为下行保护付出溢价。
- 当 S > K（OTM Call / ITM Put）：m > 0，σ 先降后略升 → 形成"smile"右翼。
- 滑块 "Skew" 控制 k，k=0 时退化为常数 IV。

**重要**：根据 Put-Call Parity，同一行权价的 Call 与 Put 必然共享同一 IV，因此图中两条 IV 曲线完全重合（put 用虚线略偏移以便辨识）。

## 🛠️ 技术栈

- 纯 HTML + CSS + 原生 JavaScript（无框架、无构建）
- [Chart.js 4.4](https://www.chartjs.org/) + annotation 插件（CDN 加载）
- 字体：Fraunces、IBM Plex Sans/Mono、Noto Sans/Serif SC（Google Fonts）

## 📁 文件结构

```
.
├── index.html      # 全部代码：HTML + CSS + JS + Black-Scholes
└── README.md       # 本文件
```

## ⚠️ 免责声明

本工具仅供教育与研究用途。Black-Scholes 模型有诸多简化假设，真实市场的期权定价与希腊字母会受到股息、跳跃、随机波动率、流动性等多种因素影响。**不构成任何投资建议。**

## 📄 License

MIT

files.name: README.md
files.content:
# Options Strategy Atlas · 期权策略图谱

An interactive reference site for **65 options strategies**, generated from `期权策略.xlsx`.

For each strategy you get:
- Full Greeks exposure (Δ, Γ, V, Θ) with color-coded direction
- Initial cash flow, trader role, purpose, structure, skill level
- Every leg with its construction and strategic effect
- A canonical **at-expiry payoff diagram** (auto-generated from the legs)

Static, no build step, no dependencies — just three files (`index.html`, `style.css`, `app.js`, `data.js`).
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Drops straight onto GitHub Pages.

---

## Local preview

Just open `index.html` in any browser. Or run a local server:

```bash
# Python
python3 -m http.server 8000
# then visit http://localhost:8000
```

---

## Deploy to GitHub Pages

### Option A — root of `main` branch (simplest)

1. Create a new repo on GitHub (e.g. `options-atlas`).
2. Copy these files into it:
   ```
   index.html
   style.css
   app.js
   data.js
   README.md
   ```
3. Commit & push:
   ```bash
   git init
   git add .
   git commit -m "Initial commit: Options Strategy Atlas"
   git branch -M main
   git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/options-atlas.git
   git push -u origin main
   ```
4. On GitHub, go to **Settings → Pages**.
5. Under **Source**, select **Deploy from a branch**, branch **`main`**, folder **`/ (root)`**, then **Save**.
6. Wait ~30 seconds. Your site will be live at `https://<your-username>.github.io/options-atlas/`.

### Option B — `docs/` folder

If you want to keep other code in the same repo:

1. Put the four files in a `docs/` subfolder.
2. Settings → Pages → branch **`main`**, folder **`/docs`**.

### Option C — GitHub Actions

For automated deploys (e.g. if you re-generate `data.js` from the Excel):

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
name: Deploy to Pages
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v4
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: '.'
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```

Then in Settings → Pages, switch the source to **GitHub Actions**.

---

## Regenerating `data.js` from the Excel file

If you update `期权策略.xlsx`, regenerate `data.js`:

```bash
pip install pandas openpyxl
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, json
df = pd.read_excel('期权策略.xlsx').fillna('')
out = []
for name in df['Strategy Name'].drop_duplicates():
    rows = df[df['Strategy Name'] == name]
    f = rows.iloc[0]
    legs = [{'construction': str(r['Leg Construction']), 'effect': str(r['Effect'])}
            for _, r in rows.iterrows() if r['Leg Construction'] or r['Effect']]
    out.append({
        'name': name, 'nickname': f['Strategy Nickame'],
        'delta': f['Delta'], 'gamma': f['Gamma'], 'vega': f['Vega'], 'theta': f['Theta'],
        'cash_flow': f['Initial Cash Flow'], 'trader_role': f['Trader Role'],
        'purpose': f['By Purpose'], 'structure': f['By Structure'],
        'skill': f['Stage of Skill Acquisition'], 'legs': legs,
    })
with open('data.js', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fp:
    fp.write('const STRATEGIES = ' + json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + ';\n')
PY
```

---

## Notes on the payoff diagrams

- Strikes are **inferred** from moneyness labels in the leg construction (`ITM ≈ 90`, `ATM = 100`, `OTM ≈ 115`, `Further OTM ≈ 130` for calls; mirrored for puts). For inner/outer condor legs, additional offsets are applied.
- Premium offsets (the vertical translation that determines breakeven) are **omitted** so each diagram shows the canonical **shape** centered around P/L = 0.
- For **Calendar / Diagonal** strategies, both legs are plotted at the same expiration as a stand-in. The actual P/L profile depends on residual time value in the longer-dated leg. The diagram caption notes this.
- Multi-leg ratios (e.g. Call Ratio Backspread) are plotted at **1:1**, since the source data doesn't encode leg ratios numerically.

These diagrams are **for visual intuition only** — not for sizing real trades.

---

## License

The site code is free to use, modify, and redistribute. The underlying strategy taxonomy is from the user's own reference file.

def embed_image(ws, path, cell_ref, row_h_pt, col_w_chars=45):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return
    pil = PILImage.open(path)
    tgt_h = int(row_h_pt * 96 / 72)
    tgt_w = int(col_w_chars * 7.5)
    pw, ph = pil.size
    scale = min(tgt_w / pw, tgt_h / ph)
    nw, nh = int(pw * scale), int(ph * scale)
    pil = pil.resize((nw, nh), PILImage.LANCZOS)
    tmp = path.replace('.png', '_xl.png')
    pil.save(tmp)
    ws.add_image(XLImage(tmp), cell_ref)

    style(dir_ws[f'C{r}'], FONT_DIR, None, LEFT, BORDER)
    dir_ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 38

dir_ws.freeze_panes = 'A3'

# === ITEM SHEETS ===
for item in items:

    ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12   # 步骤
    ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 52   # 操作说明
    ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 45   # 图片

    style(ws['A1'], FONT_TITLE, FILL_TITLE, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 36

    row = 2

    ws[f'A{row}'] = '▌ 考试流程'
    style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_SECTION, FILL_SECTION, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 26
    row += 1

    ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
    ws[f'A{row}'] = item['流程']
    style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_TEXT, FILL_FLOW, LEFT, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 52
    row += 1

    ws[f'A{row}'] = '▌ 操作步骤'

    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 26
    row += 1

    for col, h in zip(['A','B','C'], ['步骤','详细操作说明','图片参考']):

        style(c, FONT_HEADER, FILL_HEADER, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 22
    row += 1

    for step_i, (step_label, step_desc) in enumerate(item['步骤'], 1):
        fill = FILL_STEP if step_i % 2 == 1 else FILL_ALT
        
        ws[f'A{row}'] = step_label
        style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_STEP, fill, CENTER, BORDER)
        
        ws[f'B{row}'] = step_desc
        style(ws[f'B{row}'], FONT_TEXT, fill, TOP, BORDER)
        
        ws[f'C{row}'].fill = fill
        ws[f'C{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = CENTER
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = IMG_ROW_H

        img_path = f's3_images/img{idx:02d}_step{step_i:02d}.png'
        embed_image(ws, img_path, f'C{row}', IMG_ROW_H, 45)
        row += 1

    # --- 评判标准 ---
    ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
    ws[f'A{row}'] = '▌ 评判标准'
    style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_SECTION, FILL_SECTION, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 26
    row += 1

    for crit in item['评判']:
        ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
        ws[f'A{row}'] = crit
        style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_CRIT, FILL_CRIT, LEFT, BORDER)
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 28
        row += 1

    ws.freeze_panes = 'A2'

out_path = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/科目三_图文详解.xlsx'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(out_path)
print(f"Saved: {out_path}")
print(f"Sheets: {wb.sheetnames[:5]}...")

import os as _os
sz = _os.path.getsize(out_path)
print(f"File size: {sz/1024:.0f} KB")

# === STYLES ===
T = Side(border_style='thin', color='CCCCCC')
BORDER = Border(left=T, right=T, top=T, bottom=T)
OUTER = Border(left=Side(border_style='medium', color='2E75B6'),
               right=Side(border_style='medium', color='2E75B6'),
               top=Side(border_style='medium', color='2E75B6'),
               bottom=Side(border_style='medium', color='2E75B6'))

def style(cell, font=None, fill=None, align=None, border=None):
    if font:  cell.font = font
    if fill:  cell.fill = fill
    if align: cell.alignment = align
    if border: cell.border = border

FONT_TITLE  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=15, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_SECTION= Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=11, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_HEADER = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_STEP   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='1F4E78')
FONT_TEXT   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10)
FONT_CRIT   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, color='C00000')
FONT_DIR    = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10)

FILL_TITLE  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='1F4E78')
FILL_SECTION= PatternFill('solid', start_color='2E75B6')
FILL_HEADER = PatternFill('solid', start_color='5B9BD5')
FILL_STEP   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='EBF3FB')
FILL_CRIT   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFF2F2')
FILL_FLOW   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F0F7FF')
FILL_ALT    = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F8F8F8')

CENTER = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
LEFT   = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
TOP    = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='top',    wrap_text=True)

IMG_ROW_H = 140   # row height in points for step rows with images
TEXT_ROW_H = 22


def embed_image(ws, path, cell_ref, row_h_pt, col_w_chars=45):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return
    pil = PILImage.open(path)
    tgt_h = int(row_h_pt * 96 / 72)
    tgt_w = int(col_w_chars * 7.5)
    pw, ph = pil.size
    scale = min(tgt_w / pw, tgt_h / ph)
    nw, nh = int(pw * scale), int(ph * scale)
    pil = pil.resize((nw, nh), PILImage.LANCZOS)
    tmp = path.replace('.png', '_xl.png')
    pil.save(tmp)
    ws.add_image(XLImage(tmp), cell_ref)


wb = Workbook()
wb.remove(wb.active)

# === DIRECTORY SHEET ===
dir_ws = wb.create_sheet(title='目录', index=0)
dir_ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 6
dir_ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 22
dir_ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 62

dir_ws.merge_cells('A1:C1')
dir_ws['A1'] = '科目三 · 图文详解 · 考试项目目录'
style(dir_ws['A1'], FONT_TITLE, FILL_TITLE, CENTER)
dir_ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 40

for col, h in zip(['A','B','C'], ['序号','考试项目','考试流程简述']):
    c = dir_ws[f'{col}2']
    c.value = h
    style(c, FONT_HEADER, FILL_HEADER, CENTER, BORDER)
dir_ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 22

for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
    r = i + 2
    dir_ws[f'A{r}'] = i
    style(dir_ws[f'A{r}'], FONT_STEP, FILL_STEP, CENTER, BORDER)
    dir_ws[f'B{r}'] = item['name']
    style(dir_ws[f'B{r}'], Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='1F4E78'), 
          FILL_STEP, CENTER, BORDER)
    dir_ws[f'C{r}'] = item['流程']
    style(dir_ws[f'C{r}'], FONT_DIR, None, LEFT, BORDER)
    dir_ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 38

dir_ws.freeze_panes = 'A3'

# === ITEM SHEETS ===
for item in items:
    idx = item['img']
    name = item['name']
    ws = wb.create_sheet(title=f"{idx:02d}.{name}")
    
    # Column widths
    ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12   # 步骤
    ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 52   # 操作说明
    ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 45   # 图片

    # --- Title ---
    ws.merge_cells('A1:C1')
    ws['A1'] = f"{name}  ·  科目三"
    style(ws['A1'], FONT_TITLE, FILL_TITLE, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 36

    row = 2

    # --- 考试流程 ---
    ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
    ws[f'A{row}'] = '▌ 考试流程'
    style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_SECTION, FILL_SECTION, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 26
    row += 1

    ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
    ws[f'A{row}'] = item['流程']
    style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_TEXT, FILL_FLOW, LEFT, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 52
    row += 1

    # --- 操作步骤 ---
    ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
    ws[f'A{row}'] = '▌ 操作步骤'
    style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_SECTION, FILL_SECTION, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 26
    row += 1

    # Column headers
    for col, h in zip(['A','B','C'], ['步骤','详细操作说明','图片参考']):
        c = ws[f'{col}{row}']
        c.value = h
        style(c, FONT_HEADER, FILL_HEADER, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 22
    row += 1

    for step_i, (step_label, step_desc) in enumerate(item['步骤'], 1):
        fill = FILL_STEP if step_i % 2 == 1 else FILL_ALT
        
        ws[f'A{row}'] = step_label
        style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_STEP, fill, CENTER, BORDER)
        
        ws[f'B{row}'] = step_desc
        style(ws[f'B{row}'], FONT_TEXT, fill, TOP, BORDER)
        
        ws[f'C{row}'].fill = fill
        ws[f'C{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'C{row}'].alignment = CENTER
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = IMG_ROW_H

        img_path = f's3_images/img{idx:02d}_step{step_i:02d}.png'
        embed_image(ws, img_path, f'C{row}', IMG_ROW_H, 45)
        row += 1

    # --- 评判标准 ---
    ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
    ws[f'A{row}'] = '▌ 评判标准'
    style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_SECTION, FILL_SECTION, CENTER, BORDER)
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 26
    row += 1

    for crit in item['评判']:
        ws.merge_cells(f'A{row}:C{row}')
        ws[f'A{row}'] = crit
        style(ws[f'A{row}'], FONT_CRIT, FILL_CRIT, LEFT, BORDER)
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 28
        row += 1

    ws.freeze_panes = 'A2'

out_path = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/科目三_图文详解.xlsx'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(out_path)
print(f"Saved: {out_path}")
print(f"Sheets: {wb.sheetnames[:5]}...")

import os as _os
sz = _os.path.getsize(out_path)
print(f"File size: {sz/1024:.0f} KB")

  {"name":"上车准备","img":2,
   "流程":"进行指纹采集后，采用荷式开门法下车，逆时针绕车一周检查车辆外观及周围环境，在后方无来车的情况下打开车门上车。",
   "步骤":[
     ("步骤一","当听到考试指令后，采集完指纹后，采用荷式开门法下车，对车辆的外部情况进行检查。荷式开门法即用右手打开主驾车门，开门之前注意左右观察，如果后方的交通状况没有问题，再适当回头观察左后方，确保安全之后，左手将门推开一条缝隙，回头进行观望，确保安全之后，再打开车门。"),
     ("步骤二","下车，下车之后记得关闭车门。随后逆时针一周对车辆状况以及周围的交通环境进行检查。逆时针一周即从主驾位置向后方走，注意观察地面情况，包括车辆本身的情况，比如轮胎等，检查是否有危险出现。"),
     ("步骤三","有些地区需要考试学员在车辆指定位置进行触控打卡，触控打卡时需注意，手指停留在上面尽量保持三秒左右，防止漏打，记住每一个点都需要打卡。"),
     ("步骤四","随后检查车辆尾部，检查是否有异常情况，继续逆时针检查车辆的另外一侧。"),
     ("步骤五","随后回到车头位置，注意前后观察，如果交通状况安全，则回到主驾车门位置，准备用荷式开门法打开主驾车门。"),
     ("步骤六","用右手开门，打开车门的同时，注意再次前后观察交通状况，如果安全，则推开车门进入车内。"),],
   "评判":["未逆时针绕车一周检查车辆外观及周围环境的，不合格","打开车门前不观察后方交通情况的，不合格"]},
  {"name":"起步","img":3,
   "流程":"起步前检查车门是否完全关闭，调整座椅后视镜，系好安全带；检查驻车制动器、挡位，启动发动机，检查仪表，观察内外后视镜；回头观察后方交通情况，确认安全后进行起步，起步过程平稳，无闯动无后溜不熄火。",
   "步骤":[
     ("步骤一","上车之后，我们先对车辆的状况进行检查。首先检查挡位是否处在空挡，驻车制动器是否处在向上拉紧的状态。随后调整座椅，先调座椅高低，将座椅的高度调整至头部距离顶篷一拳左右的距离；然后调座椅前后，保证左脚将离合器完全踩到底，小腿和大腿呈八字形，且呈自然弯曲状态。"),
     ("步骤二","然后调节靠背。靠背调整至双手于方向盘最上端，且手肘处在自然弯曲的状态，并保证背部靠在椅背上。座椅调整完成之后，将安全带系好。"),
     ("步骤三","接下来调整车辆后视镜。左后视镜的调整，将左前车门门把手，调整至左后视镜的右下角，左右微调，保证车身占据后视镜横向面积的1/4。右侧后视镜调整方法同上，将右前车门把手调整至右边后视镜的左下角，左右微调，保证车身占据后视镜横向面积的1/4。"),
     ("步骤四","内后视镜的调整。先左右调，将后风挡的中心位置放在后视镜中间，接着上下进行微调，将远处地平线放在后视镜横向1/2的位置，内后视镜调整完毕。"),
     ("步骤五","若车辆处于熄火状态，将车辆进行点火。起步时，左脚将离合踩到底，右脚用力踩刹车，挂入1挡，松开驻车制动器，打左转向灯。"),
     ("步骤六","同时左右观察后视镜中后方的交通状况，适时的回头向左后方观察，确认后方交通状况没有问题之后，鸣笛，准备起步。"),
     ("步骤七","左脚缓抬离合，待车辆完全起步，离合完全松开之后，将方向向左打，缓慢并入主路。随后缓慢回正方向，同时注意检查转向灯是否处在关闭状态，并保持平稳驾驶。"),],
   "评判":["车门未完全关闭就起步的，不合格","起步前未观察内外后视镜，未回头观察后方交通情况的，不合格",
           "启动发动机时，挡位未置于空挡的，不合格","不松驻车制动器起步，未及时纠正的，不合格",
           "不松驻车制动器起步，但能及时纠正的，扣10分","发动机启动后不及时松开启动开关的，扣10分",
           "道路交通情况复杂时，起步不能合理使用喇叭的，扣5分","起步时车辆发生闯动的，扣5分",
           "起步时加速踏板控制不当，致使发动机转速过高的，扣5分",
           "启动发动机前不检查调整驾驶座椅、后视镜、仪表的，扣5分"]},
  {"name":"路口左转弯","img":4,

     ("步骤二","进入左转车道，在接近路口时，将车辆再次减速，并注意观察左后方，以及侧前方的交通状况，确保交通状况安全之后，保持正常行驶。"),

  {"name":"路口右转弯","img":5,

  {"name":"变更车道","img":6,
   "流程":"变更车道前，正确开启转向灯，通过内外后视镜观察，并向变更车道方向回头观察后方交通情况，确认安全后变更车道。车道变更完毕后，关闭转向灯，变更车道时，判断车辆安全距离，控制行驶速度，不得妨碍其他车辆正常行驶。",

     ("步骤二","确保安全之后，打方向变更车道，进入车道之后，缓慢回正方向，继续行驶，注意检查，保证转向灯处在关闭状态。"),],
   "评判":["变更车道前，未通过内外后视镜观察，并向变更车道方向回头观察后方交通情况的，不合格",

  {"name":"通过路口","img":7,
   "流程":"合理观察交通情况，减速或停车瞭望，根据车辆行驶方向选择相关车道，安全通过路口。",
   "步骤":[
     ("步骤一","通过路口，首先需要将车辆减速至30km/h及以内的速度区间，注意观察车辆侧前方交通状况。"),
     ("步骤二","接近路口时，注意再次减速，并且注意观察道路左右的交通状况，确保安全之后，可以正常行驶通过。如果路口有行人或者有车辆通过，必要时需停车等待，将车停在停车线以内。\n所以，当进行通过路口考试项目时，提前减速和观察是很有必要的，如果出现意外情况，可及时停车，并将车停在安全范围内；如果通过的路口有红绿灯，则需按照红绿灯的交通信号指示行驶。"),],
   "评判":["不按规定减速或停车瞭望的，不合格","不观察左右方交通情况，转弯通过路口时未观察侧前方交通状况的，不合格",

  {"name":"直线行驶","img":8,
   "流程":"根据道路情况合理控制车速，保持适当的跟车距离，正确使用挡位，保持直线行驶，车速平稳，视线不得离开行驶方向超过两秒。",
   "步骤":[
     ("步骤一","直线行驶，双手握在方向盘的三九点，肩部放松，手肘自然下垂，握方向盘的力度不宜太紧（太紧反而容易跑方向）。\n眼睛看至前方道路的远端，不要看车头位置，若看车头位置，反而更容易下意识修方向，车身则更容易走偏，脚下将油门控制平稳。"),],
   "评判":["方向控制不稳、不能保持车辆直线运行的，不合格","遇前车制动时、不及时采取减速措施的，不合格",

  {"name":"加减挡位","img":9,
   "流程":"根据路况和车速，合理进行加减挡操作，选择合适时机进行换挡，使车辆平顺行驶。",
   "步骤":[
     ("步骤一","直线加减挡，需意加挡和减挡的时机。加挡时，当车速处在40km/h时，可从五挡减至四挡；当车速处在30km/h时，可减至三挡；处在20km/h时，可减至二挡；处在10km/h及以下时，则减至一挡（即五加挡零减挡）。\n首先加挡时，先踩油门提速。当速度达到需要换挡的区间之后，松开油门。"),
     ("步骤二","左脚将离合踩到底，然后进行加挡，随后抬离合，等离合完全松开之后，右脚再踩油门提速。"),
     ("步骤三","等到换挡时机时，右脚松开油门，同时左脚将离合踩到底。"),
     ("步骤四","再次进行加挡，左脚抬离合，等离合完全放开之后，右脚踩油门，再次提速加挡。做加挡时，需一挡一挡往上加，禁止出现越级加挡的情况。\n做减挡操作时，首先右脚松开油门，并且慢踩刹车，等车速降到一定区间之后，松开刹车，左脚将离合踩到底，进行减挡操作。然后左脚缓抬离合，等离合完全松开之后，再踩刹车减速，减到一定速度区间之后，松开刹车再踩离合，再次进行减挡操作，然后缓慢抬离合，至离合完全松开。在做减挡动作时，踩刹车一定要慢踩，防止出现车速突然降低的情况。"),],
   "评判":["未按指令平稳加减挡的，不合格","车辆运行速度和挡位不匹配的，扣10分"]},
  {"name":"通过公交汽车站","img":10,

  {"name":"通过人行横道线","img":11,

  {"name":"超车","img":13,
   "流程":"超车前保持与被超越车辆的安全跟车距离，开启左转向灯选择合理时机，从被超越车辆左侧超越，超车时观察被超越车辆的情况，保持横向安全距离，超越后开启右转向灯，在确认不影响被超越车辆正常行驶的情况下，逐渐驶回原车道，并关闭转向灯。",

     ("步骤二","变道完成之后，可以适当提速超越车辆。超越车辆之后，保持一段直行，等与后方车辆拉开足够距离之后，再打右转向灯，保持三秒以上，继续观察左右后视镜，适当向右后方回头观察交通状况。"),
     ("步骤三","确保安全之后，向右进行变道，回到原来的行驶车道，随后保持正常速度行驶，并注意检查转向灯是否处在关闭状态。"),],
   "评判":["超车前不通过内外后视镜观察后方和左侧交通情况并回头观察确认安全的，不合格",
           "超车时机选择不合理影响其他车辆正常行驶的，不合格","超车时未回头观察被超越车辆动态的，不合格",
           "超车时未与被超越车辆保持安全距离的，不合格",

  {"name":"掉头","img":14,
   "流程":"减速车辆并开启转向灯，在合适的时机进入掉头车道，减速或停车进行瞭望，确保安全后进行掉头，掉头时不妨碍其他车辆和行人的正常通行。",

           "会车困难时不让行的，不合格","横向安全间距判断差，紧急转向避让对方来车的，不合格"]},
  {"name":"靠边停车","img":16,
   "流程":"减速，开启右转向灯，通过内外后视镜，观察后方和右侧交通情况，确认安全后，减速，向右转向，靠边平稳停车；回空挡，拉紧驻车制动器，关闭转向灯。车身距道路右侧边缘线或人行道边缘30cm以内。需要下车的学员，回头观察左后方交通情况，确认安全后缓慢打开车门，下车后关闭车门。",

     ("步骤三","等车辆走直之后，再踩脚刹车，停车。"),

   "评判":["停车前，不通过内外后视镜观察后方和右侧交通状况、不回头观察确认安全的，不合格",
           "考试员发出靠边停车指令后，未能在规定的距离内停车的，不合格",
           "车身超过道路右侧边缘线或人行道边缘的，不合格",
           "需要下车的，在打开车门前不回头观察左后方交通状况的，不合格",
           "下车后，不关闭车门的，不合格","停车后，车身距道路右侧边缘或人行道边缘超出50cm的，不合格",
           "停车后，车身距离道路右侧边缘超出30cm，不合格（30cm以内的）",
           "停车后，未拉紧驻车制动器的，扣10分","拉紧驻车制动器前，放松行车制动踏板的，扣10分",
           "下车前不将发动机熄火的，扣5分"]},
]

# ── STYLES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
T  = Side(border_style='thin',   color='CCCCCC')
MB = Side(border_style='medium', color='2E75B6')
BD = Border(left=T, right=T, top=T, bottom=T)

def st(cell, font=None, fill=None, align=None, border=BD):
    if font:   cell.font   = font
    if fill:   cell.fill   = fill
    if align:  cell.alignment = align
    if border: cell.border = border

F_MAIN  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=16, bold=True,  color='FFFFFF')
F_ITEM  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=11, bold=True,  color='FFFFFF')
F_SEC   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True,  color='FFFFFF')
F_COL   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True,  color='FFFFFF')
F_SLBL  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True,  color='1F4E78')
F_TEXT  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10)
F_CRIT  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, color='C00000')

P_MAIN  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='1F4E78')
P_ITEM  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='2E75B6')
P_SEC   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='5B9BD5')
P_COL   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='8DB4E2')
P_ODD   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='EBF3FB')
P_EVEN  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F7FBFF')
P_FLOW  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F0F7FF')
P_CRIT  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFF2F2')

CTR = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
LFT = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
TOP = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='top',    wrap_text=True)

# ── IMAGE COLUMN SETTINGS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
IMG_COL_IDX  = 4          # E = column index 4 (0-based)
IMG_COL_W    = 42         # Excel character units
IMG_ROW_H_PT = 140        # row height in points
IMG_PAD_PX   = 6          # pixel padding inside cell on each side

# Pixel dimensions of the image cell
CELL_W_PX = int(IMG_COL_W * 7 + 5)          # ≈ 299 px
CELL_H_PX = int(IMG_ROW_H_PT * 96 / 72)     # ≈ 187 px
MAX_W = CELL_W_PX - IMG_PAD_PX * 2          # 287 px usable width
MAX_H = CELL_H_PX - IMG_PAD_PX * 2          # 175 px usable height
PAD_EMU = IMG_PAD_PX * 9525                 # padding in EMU


def embed(ws, img_path, xl_row):            # xl_row is 1-based Excel row number
    """Resize image and anchor it with TwoCellAnchor inside cell E{xl_row}."""
    if not os.path.exists(img_path):
        return
    pil = PILImage.open(img_path)
    scale = min(MAX_W / pil.width, MAX_H / pil.height)
    nw = max(1, int(pil.width  * scale))
    nh = max(1, int(pil.height * scale))
    pil = pil.resize((nw, nh), PILImage.LANCZOS)
    tmp = img_path.replace('.png', '_xl.png')
    pil.save(tmp)

    xl_img = XLImage(tmp)
    xl_img.width  = nw
    xl_img.height = nh

    r0 = xl_row - 1                         # 0-based row for AnchorMarker
    anc = TwoCellAnchor()
    anc._from = AnchorMarker(col=IMG_COL_IDX,   colOff=PAD_EMU, row=r0,   rowOff=PAD_EMU)
    anc.to    = AnchorMarker(col=IMG_COL_IDX+1, colOff=-PAD_EMU,row=r0+1, rowOff=-PAD_EMU)
    anc.editAs = 'twoCell'
    xl_img.anchor = anc
    ws.add_image(xl_img)


# ── BUILD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = '科目三·图文详解'

# Column widths
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 10
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 50
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 38
ws.column_dimensions['E'].width = IMG_COL_W

# Main title
ws.merge_cells('A1:E1')
st(ws['A1'], F_MAIN, P_MAIN, CTR)
ws['A1'] = '科目三 · 图文详解 · 全项目考试要点'
ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 44

# Column headers
for col, h in zip('ABCDE', ['考试项目', '步骤', '详细操作说明', '评判标准', '图片参考']):
    c = ws[f'{col}2']
    c.value = h
    st(c, F_COL, P_COL, CTR)
ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 24

row = 3

for item in items:
    idx    = item['img']
    steps  = item['步骤']
    crits  = item['评判']
    n_steps = len(steps)
    item_start = row

    # Exam flow row
    ws[f'B{row}'] = '考试流程'
    st(ws[f'B{row}'], F_SEC, P_SEC, CTR)
    ws.merge_cells(f'C{row}:D{row}')
    st(ws[f'C{row}'], F_TEXT, P_FLOW, LFT)
    ws[f'C{row}'] = item['流程']
    ws[f'E{row}'].fill = P_FLOW
    ws[f'E{row}'].border = BD
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 52
    row += 1

    # Step rows
    for si, (lbl, desc) in enumerate(steps, 1):
        fill = P_ODD if si % 2 else P_EVEN
        crit = crits[si - 1] if si <= len(crits) else ''

        ws[f'B{row}'] = lbl
        st(ws[f'B{row}'], F_SLBL, fill, CTR)
        ws[f'C{row}'] = desc
        st(ws[f'C{row}'], F_TEXT, fill, TOP)
        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit
        st(ws[f'D{row}'], F_CRIT if crit else F_TEXT,
           P_CRIT if crit else fill, TOP if crit else CTR)
        ws[f'E{row}'].fill   = fill
        ws[f'E{row}'].border = BD
        ws[f'E{row}'].alignment = CTR
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = IMG_ROW_H_PT

        embed(ws, f's3_images/img{idx:02d}_step{si:02d}.png', row)
        row += 1

    # Extra criteria rows (beyond step count)
    for crit in crits[n_steps:]:
        for col in 'BCDE':
            ws[f'{col}{row}'].fill   = P_CRIT
            ws[f'{col}{row}'].border = BD
        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit
        st(ws[f'D{row}'], F_CRIT, P_CRIT, TOP)
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 28
        row += 1

    # Merge column A for entire item block
    end = row - 1
    if end > item_start:
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=item_start, start_column=1,
                       end_row=end, end_column=1)
    ca = ws.cell(row=item_start, column=1)
    ca.value = f"{idx:02d}\n{item['name']}"
    ca.font  = F_ITEM
    ca.fill  = P_ITEM
    ca.alignment = CTR
    ca.border = Border(left=MB, right=MB, top=MB, bottom=MB)

ws.freeze_panes = 'B3'

out = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/科目三_图文详解.xlsx'
wb.save(out)
print(f"Saved: {out}")

from openpyxl import load_workbook as lw
wb2 = lw(out)
ws2 = wb2.active
print(f"Sheet: {ws2.title}  |  Dims: {ws2.dimensions}  |  Images: {len(ws2._images)}")
print(f"File: {os.path.getsize(out)//1024} KB")

"""科目三 single-sheet Excel — images anchored inside cells via TwoCellAnchor."""
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.drawing.image import Image as XLImage
from openpyxl.drawing.spreadsheet_drawing import TwoCellAnchor, AnchorMarker
from PIL import Image as PILImage
import os

# ── DATA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
items = [
  {"name":"模拟夜间灯光使用","img":1,

  {"name":"上车准备","img":2,
   "流程":"进行指纹采集后，采用荷式开门法下车，逆时针绕车一周检查车辆外观及周围环境，在后方无来车的情况下打开车门上车。",
   "步骤":[
     ("步骤一","当听到考试指令后，采集完指纹后，采用荷式开门法下车，对车辆的外部情况进行检查。荷式开门法即用右手打开主驾车门，开门之前注意左右观察，如果后方的交通状况没有问题，再适当回头观察左后方，确保安全之后，左手将门推开一条缝隙，回头进行观望，确保安全之后，再打开车门。"),

# ── IMAGE COLUMN SETTINGS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
IMG_COL_IDX  = 4          # E = column index 4 (0-based)
IMG_COL_W    = 42         # Excel character units
IMG_ROW_H_PT = 140        # row height in points
IMG_PAD_PX   = 6          # pixel padding inside cell on each side

# Pixel dimensions of the image cell
CELL_W_PX = int(IMG_COL_W * 7 + 5)          # ≈ 299 px
CELL_H_PX = int(IMG_ROW_H_PT * 96 / 72)     # ≈ 187 px
MAX_W = CELL_W_PX - IMG_PAD_PX * 2          # 287 px usable width
MAX_H = CELL_H_PX - IMG_PAD_PX * 2          # 175 px usable height
PAD_EMU = IMG_PAD_PX * 9525                 # padding in EMU


def embed(ws, img_path, xl_row):            # xl_row is 1-based Excel row number
    """Resize image and anchor it with TwoCellAnchor inside cell E{xl_row}."""
    if not os.path.exists(img_path):
        return
    pil = PILImage.open(img_path)
    scale = min(MAX_W / pil.width, MAX_H / pil.height)
    nw = max(1, int(pil.width  * scale))
    nh = max(1, int(pil.height * scale))
    pil = pil.resize((nw, nh), PILImage.LANCZOS)
    tmp = img_path.replace('.png', '_xl.png')
    pil.save(tmp)

    xl_img = XLImage(tmp)
    xl_img.width  = nw
    xl_img.height = nh

    r0 = xl_row - 1                         # 0-based row for AnchorMarker
    anc = TwoCellAnchor()

# Column headers

for item in items:
    idx    = item['img']
    steps  = item['步骤']
    crits  = item['评判']

    ws.merge_cells(f'C{row}:D{row}')

    ws[f'E{row}'].border = BD
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 52
    row += 1

    # Step rows
    for si, (lbl, desc) in enumerate(steps, 1):

        crit = crits[si - 1] if si <= len(crits) else ''

        ws[f'B{row}'] = lbl
        st(ws[f'B{row}'], F_SLBL, fill, CTR)
        ws[f'C{row}'] = desc
        st(ws[f'C{row}'], F_TEXT, fill, TOP)
        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit
        st(ws[f'D{row}'], F_CRIT if crit else F_TEXT,
           P_CRIT if crit else fill, TOP if crit else CTR)
        ws[f'E{row}'].fill   = fill
        ws[f'E{row}'].border = BD
        ws[f'E{row}'].alignment = CTR

    # Extra criteria rows (beyond step count)
    for crit in crits[n_steps:]:

            ws[f'{col}{row}'].border = BD
        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit
        st(ws[f'D{row}'], F_CRIT, P_CRIT, TOP)
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 28
        row += 1

    # Merge column A for entire item block
    end = row - 1
    if end > item_start:
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=item_start, start_column=1,
                       end_row=end, end_column=1)
    ca = ws.cell(row=item_start, column=1)
    ca.value = f"{idx:02d}\n{item['name']}"
    ca.font  = F_ITEM
    ca.fill  = P_ITEM
    ca.alignment = CTR
    ca.border = Border(left=MB, right=MB, top=MB, bottom=MB)

ws.freeze_panes = 'B3'

out = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/科目三_图文详解.xlsx'
wb.save(out)
print(f"Saved: {out}")

from openpyxl import load_workbook as lw
wb2 = lw(out)
ws2 = wb2.active
print(f"Sheet: {ws2.title}  |  Dims: {ws2.dimensions}  |  Images: {len(ws2._images)}")
print(f"File: {os.path.getsize(out)//1024} KB")

# ===== STYLES =====
T = Side(border_style='thin', color='CCCCCC')
M = Side(border_style='medium', color='2E75B6')
BORDER  = Border(left=T, right=T, top=T, bottom=T)

def s(cell, font=None, fill=None, align=None, border=BORDER):
    if font:   cell.font = font
    if fill:   cell.fill = fill
    if align:  cell.alignment = align
    if border: cell.border = border

FONT_MAIN_TITLE = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=16, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_ITEM_HDR   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=13, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_SEC_HDR    = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_COL_HDR    = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_STEP_LBL   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='1F4E78')
FONT_TEXT       = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10)
FONT_CRIT       = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, color='C00000')

FILL_MAIN_TITLE = PatternFill('solid', start_color='1F4E78')
FILL_ITEM_HDR   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='2E75B6')
FILL_SEC_HDR    = PatternFill('solid', start_color='5B9BD5')
FILL_COL_HDR    = PatternFill('solid', start_color='8DB4E2')
FILL_STEP_ODD   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='EBF3FB')
FILL_STEP_EVEN  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F7FBFF')
FILL_FLOW       = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F0F7FF')
FILL_CRIT       = PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFF2F2')

CENTER = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
LEFT   = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
TOP    = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='top',    wrap_text=True)

IMG_H = 140   # row height pts for image rows

def embed(ws, path, cell_ref, row_h, col_w=42):
    if not os.path.exists(path): return
    pil = PILImage.open(path)
    tgt_h = int(row_h * 96 / 72)
    tgt_w = int(col_w * 7.5)
    pw, ph = pil.size
    sc = min(tgt_w / pw, tgt_h / ph)
    pil = pil.resize((int(pw*sc), int(ph*sc)), PILImage.LANCZOS)
    tmp = path.replace('.png', '_xl.png')
    pil.save(tmp)
    ws.add_image(XLImage(tmp), cell_ref)

# ===== BUILD =====
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = '科目三·图文详解'

# Column widths: A=考试项目, B=步骤, C=操作说明, D=评判标准, E=图片
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12   # 考试项目
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 10   # 步骤
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 50   # 操作说明
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 38   # 评判标准
ws.column_dimensions['E'].width = 42   # 图片

# Main title row
ws.merge_cells('A1:E1')
ws['A1'] = '科目三 · 图文详解 · 全项目考试要点'
s(ws['A1'], FONT_MAIN_TITLE, FILL_MAIN_TITLE, CENTER)
ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 44

# Column header row
for col, h in zip('ABCDE', ['考试项目', '步骤', '详细操作说明', '评判标准', '图片参考']):
    c = ws[f'{col}2']
    c.value = h
    s(c, FONT_COL_HDR, FILL_COL_HDR, CENTER)
ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 24

row = 3

for item in items:
    idx   = item['img']
    name  = item['name']
    steps = item['步骤']
    crits = item['评判']
    n_steps = len(steps)

    # ── Item header spanning all step rows (for columns A only; merged vertically later)
    item_start_row = row

    # ── 考试流程 row (full width minus A, which is the item name)
    # We'll put 考试流程 in C (merged B:D)
    # Row layout: A=item name (merged for all steps), B="考试流程", C:D=流程text, E=empty
    flow_row = row
    ws[f'B{row}'] = '考试流程'
    s(ws[f'B{row}'], FONT_SEC_HDR, FILL_SEC_HDR, CENTER)
    ws.merge_cells(f'C{row}:D{row}')
    ws[f'C{row}'] = item['流程']
    s(ws[f'C{row}'], FONT_TEXT, FILL_FLOW, LEFT)
    ws[f'E{row}'].border = BORDER
    ws[f'E{row}'].fill = FILL_FLOW
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 50
    row += 1

    # ── Step rows
    for si, (step_label, step_desc) in enumerate(steps, 1):
        fill = FILL_STEP_ODD if si % 2 == 1 else FILL_STEP_EVEN
        crit_text = crits[si - 1] if si <= len(crits) else ''

        ws[f'B{row}'] = step_label
        s(ws[f'B{row}'], FONT_STEP_LBL, fill, CENTER)

        ws[f'C{row}'] = step_desc
        s(ws[f'C{row}'], FONT_TEXT, fill, TOP)

        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit_text
        s(ws[f'D{row}'], FONT_CRIT, FILL_CRIT if crit_text else fill,
          TOP if crit_text else CENTER)

        ws[f'E{row}'].fill = fill
        ws[f'E{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'E{row}'].alignment = CENTER
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = IMG_H

        img_path = f's3_images/img{idx:02d}_step{si:02d}.png'
        embed(ws, img_path, f'E{row}', IMG_H, 42)
        row += 1

    # ── Extra criteria rows (beyond step count)
    for ci, crit in enumerate(crits[n_steps:], n_steps + 1):
        ws[f'B{row}'] = ''
        ws[f'B{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'B{row}'].fill = FILL_CRIT
        ws[f'C{row}'] = ''
        ws[f'C{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'C{row}'].fill = FILL_CRIT
        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit
        s(ws[f'D{row}'], FONT_CRIT, FILL_CRIT, TOP)
        ws[f'E{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'E{row}'].fill = FILL_CRIT
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 28
        row += 1

    # ── Merge column A for entire item block (flow + steps + extra crits)
    item_end_row = row - 1
    if item_end_row > item_start_row:
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=item_start_row, start_column=1,
                       end_row=item_end_row,   end_column=1)
    cell_a = ws.cell(row=item_start_row, column=1)
    cell_a.value = f"{idx:02d}\n{name}"
    cell_a.font  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=11, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
    cell_a.fill  = FILL_ITEM_HDR
    cell_a.alignment = CENTER
    cell_a.border = Border(left=M, right=M, top=M, bottom=M)

ws.freeze_panes = 'B3'

out = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/科目三_图文详解.xlsx'
wb.save(out)
print(f"Saved: {out}")

from openpyxl import load_workbook as lw
wb2 = lw(out)
ws2 = wb2.active
print(f"Sheet: {ws2.title}")
print(f"Dims: {ws2.dimensions}, Images: {len(ws2._images)}")
print(f"Rows: {ws2.max_row}")

import os as _os
print(f"Size: {_os.path.getsize(out)//1024} KB")

def s(cell, font=None, fill=None, align=None, border=BORDER):

    if fill:   cell.fill = fill
    if align:  cell.alignment = align

FONT_COL_HDR    = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
FONT_STEP_LBL   = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, bold=True, color='1F4E78')
FONT_TEXT       = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10)
FONT_CRIT       = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=10, color='C00000')

FILL_MAIN_TITLE = PatternFill('solid', start_color='1F4E78')
FILL_ITEM_HDR   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='2E75B6')
FILL_SEC_HDR    = PatternFill('solid', start_color='5B9BD5')
FILL_COL_HDR    = PatternFill('solid', start_color='8DB4E2')
FILL_STEP_ODD   = PatternFill('solid', start_color='EBF3FB')
FILL_STEP_EVEN  = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F7FBFF')
FILL_FLOW       = PatternFill('solid', start_color='F0F7FF')
FILL_CRIT       = PatternFill('solid', start_color='FFF2F2')

TOP    = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='top',    wrap_text=True)

IMG_H = 140   # row height pts for image rows

def embed(ws, path, cell_ref, row_h, col_w=42):
    if not os.path.exists(path): return
    pil = PILImage.open(path)
    tgt_h = int(row_h * 96 / 72)
    tgt_w = int(col_w * 7.5)
    pw, ph = pil.size
    sc = min(tgt_w / pw, tgt_h / ph)
    pil = pil.resize((int(pw*sc), int(ph*sc)), PILImage.LANCZOS)
    tmp = path.replace('.png', '_xl.png')
    pil.save(tmp)
    ws.add_image(XLImage(tmp), cell_ref)

ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12   # 考试项目
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 10   # 步骤
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 50   # 操作说明
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 38   # 评判标准
ws.column_dimensions['E'].width = 42   # 图片

# Main title row
ws.merge_cells('A1:E1')
ws['A1'] = '科目三 · 图文详解 · 全项目考试要点'
s(ws['A1'], FONT_MAIN_TITLE, FILL_MAIN_TITLE, CENTER)
ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 44

# Column header row
for col, h in zip('ABCDE', ['考试项目', '步骤', '详细操作说明', '评判标准', '图片参考']):

    c.value = h
    s(c, FONT_COL_HDR, FILL_COL_HDR, CENTER)
ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 24

row = 3

for item in items:
    idx   = item['img']
    name  = item['name']
    steps = item['步骤']
    crits = item['评判']
    n_steps = len(steps)

    # ── Item header spanning all step rows (for columns A only; merged vertically later)
    item_start_row = row

    # ── 考试流程 row (full width minus A, which is the item name)
    # We'll put 考试流程 in C (merged B:D)
    # Row layout: A=item name (merged for all steps), B="考试流程", C:D=流程text, E=empty
    flow_row = row
    ws[f'B{row}'] = '考试流程'
    s(ws[f'B{row}'], FONT_SEC_HDR, FILL_SEC_HDR, CENTER)
    ws.merge_cells(f'C{row}:D{row}')
    ws[f'C{row}'] = item['流程']
    s(ws[f'C{row}'], FONT_TEXT, FILL_FLOW, LEFT)
    ws[f'E{row}'].border = BORDER
    ws[f'E{row}'].fill = FILL_FLOW
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 50
    row += 1

    # ── Step rows
    for si, (step_label, step_desc) in enumerate(steps, 1):
        fill = FILL_STEP_ODD if si % 2 == 1 else FILL_STEP_EVEN
        crit_text = crits[si - 1] if si <= len(crits) else ''

        ws[f'B{row}'] = step_label
        s(ws[f'B{row}'], FONT_STEP_LBL, fill, CENTER)

        ws[f'C{row}'] = step_desc
        s(ws[f'C{row}'], FONT_TEXT, fill, TOP)

        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit_text
        s(ws[f'D{row}'], FONT_CRIT, FILL_CRIT if crit_text else fill,
          TOP if crit_text else CENTER)

        ws[f'E{row}'].fill = fill
        ws[f'E{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'E{row}'].alignment = CENTER
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = IMG_H

        img_path = f's3_images/img{idx:02d}_step{si:02d}.png'
        embed(ws, img_path, f'E{row}', IMG_H, 42)
        row += 1

    # ── Extra criteria rows (beyond step count)
    for ci, crit in enumerate(crits[n_steps:], n_steps + 1):
        ws[f'B{row}'] = ''
        ws[f'B{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'B{row}'].fill = FILL_CRIT
        ws[f'C{row}'] = ''
        ws[f'C{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'C{row}'].fill = FILL_CRIT
        ws[f'D{row}'] = crit
        s(ws[f'D{row}'], FONT_CRIT, FILL_CRIT, TOP)
        ws[f'E{row}'].border = BORDER
        ws[f'E{row}'].fill = FILL_CRIT
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 28
        row += 1

    # ── Merge column A for entire item block (flow + steps + extra crits)
    item_end_row = row - 1
    if item_end_row > item_start_row:
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=item_start_row, start_column=1,
                       end_row=item_end_row,   end_column=1)
    cell_a = ws.cell(row=item_start_row, column=1)
    cell_a.value = f"{idx:02d}\n{name}"
    cell_a.font  = Font(name='Microsoft YaHei', size=11, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
    cell_a.fill  = FILL_ITEM_HDR
    cell_a.alignment = CENTER
    cell_a.border = Border(left=M, right=M, top=M, bottom=M)

ws.freeze_panes = 'B3'

out = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/科目三_图文详解.xlsx'
wb.save(out)
print(f"Saved: {out}")

from openpyxl import load_workbook as lw
wb2 = lw(out)
ws2 = wb2.active
print(f"Sheet: {ws2.title}")
print(f"Dims: {ws2.dimensions}, Images: {len(ws2._images)}")
print(f"Rows: {ws2.max_row}")

import os as _os
print(f"Size: {_os.path.getsize(out)//1024} KB")

def add_image_to_cell(ws, img_path, cell, row_height_pt, col_width_chars):
    """Embed an image into a specific cell, sized to fit."""
    if not os.path.exists(img_path):
        return
    # Resize image to a target display size
    pil_img = PILImage.open(img_path)
    target_h_px = int(row_height_pt * 96 / 72)  # convert points to pixels (96 DPI)
    target_w_px = int(col_width_chars * 7)       # ~7 px per char width
    # Maintain aspect ratio - scale to fit in cell
    pw, ph = pil_img.size
    scale = min(target_w_px / pw, target_h_px / ph)
    new_w, new_h = int(pw * scale), int(ph * scale)
    pil_img = pil_img.resize((new_w, new_h), PILImage.LANCZOS)
    tmp_path = img_path.replace('.png', '_resized.png')
    pil_img.save(tmp_path)
    xl_img = XLImage(tmp_path)
    ws.add_image(xl_img, cell)

import re
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from copy import copy
from datetime import datetime


def parse_row(row):
    """从一行 web scraper 数据中按内容识别字段。"""
    rec = {
        '小区': '', '户型': '', '建筑面积': None,
        '成交日期': None, '成交总价': '',
        '朝向': '', '装修': '',
        '建成年代': '', '结构': '',
        '地铁信息': '', '挂牌价': '',
        '成交周期': '', '成交单价': '',
        '是否满五年': '否',
    }
    data_field = row[2] or ''
    date_field = row[3] or ''
    total_price = row[4]

    # data 字段: "小区 户型 面积平米"
    m = re.match(r'^(.+?)\s+(\d+室\d+厅)\s+([\d.]+)平米$', data_field.strip())
    if m:
        rec['小区'] = m.group(1)
        rec['户型'] = m.group(2)
        rec['建筑面积'] = float(m.group(3))

    # 成交日期 "2026.03.21"
    if date_field:
        try:
            rec['成交日期'] = datetime.strptime(str(date_field).strip(), '%Y.%m.%d')
        except ValueError:
            pass

    if total_price is not None:
        rec['成交总价'] = str(total_price)

    # 按内容识别 6-13 列
    for i in range(6, 14):
        v = row[i]
        if v is None or v == '':
            continue
        s = str(v).strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if ' | ' in s:
            parts = s.split(' | ')
            rec['朝向'] = parts[0].strip() + ' '   # 朝向末尾保留空格以匹配标准格式
            rec['装修'] = parts[1].strip()
        elif '楼层(共' in s and '年' in s:
            m2 = re.match(r'^(.+?层\)) (.+)$', s)
            if m2:
                rec['结构'] = m2.group(1)
                rec['建成年代'] = m2.group(2)
        elif s.startswith('挂牌') and s.endswith('万'):
            price_str = s[2:-1].strip()
            try:
                rec['挂牌价'] = float(price_str) if '.' in price_str else int(price_str)
            except ValueError:
                rec['挂牌价'] = price_str
        elif s.startswith('成交周期') and s.endswith('天'):
            cycle_str = s[4:-1].strip()
            try:
                rec['成交周期'] = int(cycle_str)
            except ValueError:
                rec['成交周期'] = cycle_str
        elif s.startswith('距') and '号线' in s:
            rec['地铁信息'] = s
        elif '房屋满五' in s:
            rec['是否满五年'] = '是'

    # 单价：从 price2 列（不同文件中位置不同）找一个纯数字
    for i in [11, 10, 9, 8]:
        v = row[i]
        if v is None:
            continue
        sv = str(v).strip()
        if sv and '元/平' not in sv and sv.replace('.', '').isdigit():
            rec['成交单价'] = str(int(float(sv)))
            break

    return rec


# === 1. 读取所有源文件 ===
src_files = [
    'sz-ke-com-2026-05-13-2.xlsx',
    'sz-ke-com-2026-05-13-2__1_.xlsx',
    'sz-ke-com-2026-05-13-2__2_.xlsx',
    'sz-ke-com-2026-05-13-2__3_.xlsx',
    'sz-ke-com-2026-05-13-2__4_.xlsx',
]
all_records = []
for f in src_files:
    wb_src = load_workbook(f)
    ws_src = wb_src['Sheet1']
    for row in ws_src.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        if row[2] is None:
            continue
        all_records.append(parse_row(row))

# === 2. 去重 ===
seen = set()
unique_records = []
for r in all_records:
    key = (r['小区'], r['户型'], r['建筑面积'], r['成交日期'], r['成交总价'])
    if key not in seen:
        seen.add(key)
        unique_records.append(r)

# === 3. 按"成交日期降序"排序，保持与原文件一致的排序规律 ===
unique_records.sort(
    key=lambda r: r['成交日期'] if r['成交日期'] else datetime(1900, 1, 1),
    reverse=True,
)

print(f"原始 {len(all_records)} 条 -> 去重后 {len(unique_records)} 条")

# === 4. 打开标准文件并追加 ===
wb = load_workbook('房产信息.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

start_row = ws.max_row + 1
# 取最大序号
last_serial = 0
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=1, values_only=True):
    try:
        s = int(row[0])
        if s > last_serial:
            last_serial = s
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        pass

# 复制最后一行每列的格式作为模板
template_row = ws.max_row
col_formats = {}
for col in range(1, 16):
    c = ws.cell(row=template_row, column=col)
    col_formats[col] = {
        'font': copy(c.font),
        'alignment': copy(c.alignment),
        'number_format': c.number_format,
    }

# 列映射（按标准文件实际的数据排列方式，注意 I=楼层/结构, J=建成年代）：
#   1=序号  2=小区  3=户型  4=建筑面积  5=成交日期  6=成交总价
#   7=朝向  8=装修  9=结构  10=建成年代  11=地铁信息  12=挂牌价
#   13=成交周期  14=成交单价  15=是否满五年

# 重要：标准文件中"成交总价"和"挂牌价"等列虽显示为右对齐的数字，但有些是 str 类型，
# 有些是 int 类型；这里参考最后几行均为 str 类型存储"成交总价"，int 存储挂牌价/周期。
# 单价存为 str。保持与现有数据一致。

def write_cell(cell, value, fmt):
    cell.value = value
    cell.font = copy(fmt['font'])
    cell.alignment = copy(fmt['alignment'])
    cell.number_format = fmt['number_format']

for i, rec in enumerate(unique_records):
    serial = last_serial + 1 + i
    r_idx = start_row + i
    row_values = [
        str(serial),
        rec['小区'],
        rec['户型'],
        rec['建筑面积'],          # float
        rec['成交日期'],          # datetime
        rec['成交总价'],          # str
        rec['朝向'],
        rec['装修'],
        rec['结构'],              # I 列 - 楼层信息
        rec['建成年代'],          # J 列 - 建成年代
        rec['地铁信息'],
        rec['挂牌价'],            # int/float
        rec['成交周期'],          # int
        rec['成交单价'],          # str
        rec['是否满五年'],
    ]
    for col_idx, val in enumerate(row_values, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=r_idx, column=col_idx)
        write_cell(cell, val, col_formats[col_idx])

# === 5. 保存 ===
out_path = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/房产信息.xlsx'
import os
os.makedirs('/mnt/user-data/outputs', exist_ok=True)
wb.save(out_path)
print(f"已保存: {out_path}")
print(f"最终总行数: {ws.max_row} (含标题)，新增 {len(unique_records)} 条")
